example_zh: 他被指控虐待動物。

example_en: The police car is a type of cruiser.
example_zh: 警車是一種巡邏車。

definition_zh: 碎屑（尤指麵包或糕餅的）
example_en: He brushed the crumbs from his shirt.
example_zh: 他把褲子上的碎屑刷掉。

example_en: The old building started to crumble over time.
example_zh: 這座老建築隨著時間開始崩塌。

definition_zh: 嘎吱作響地咀嚼；嘎吱作響
example_en: I could hear the leaves crunch under his boots.
example_zh: 我能聽見樹葉在他靴子下嘎吱作響。

example_en: I love eating crunchy apples.
example_zh: 我喜歡吃爽脆的蘋果。

example_en: The car was completely crushed in the accident.
example_zh: 那輛車在事故中完全被撞毀了。
special_usage: 作為名詞時可指「短暫的迷戀」（e.g., a schoolboy crush）

example_en: He only eats the pizza crust if it's garlic bread.
example_zh: 除非是蒜蓉麵包，否則他只吃披薩的餅皮邊。

example_en: He walked on crutches for six weeks after breaking his leg.
example_zh: 他摔斷腿後，拄了六週的拐杖。
special_usage: 亦可用於比喻「心靈支柱」或「依賴的人/物」

example_en: The lioness protected her cubs fiercely.
example_zh: 母獅兇猛地保護牠的幼崽。

example_en: She added sliced cucumber to the salad.
example_zh: 她把切片的黃瓜加進沙拉裡。
special_usage: 片語 'as cool as a cucumber' 意為「非常冷靜」

example_en: The actor waited for his cue to enter the stage.
example_zh: 演員等待著上台的提示。
special_usage: 亦可作動詞，意為「給（某人）提示」

example_en: The festival culminated in a spectacular fireworks display.
example_zh: 這場節慶以一場壯觀的煙火表演作為高潮。

example_en: He likes to cultivate vegetables in his backyard.
example_zh: 他喜歡在後院種植蔬菜。
special_usage: 比喻義指「培養關係或態度」（e.g., cultivate friends）

example_en: The cunning fox tricked the hunter.
example_zh: 狡猾的狐狸騙了獵人。

example_en: Please put the plates in the cupboard.
example_zh: 請把盤子放進櫥櫃裡。

example_en: You should try to curb your temper.
example_zh: 你應該試著控制你的脾氣。
special_usage: 作為名詞指「路緣（馬路邊）」

example_en: My parents set a strict curfew of 10 PM.
example_zh: 我父母設定了嚴格的晚上十點門禁時間。

example_en: Her curiosity led her to explore the abandoned house.
example_zh: 她的好奇心驅使她去探索那棟廢棄的房子。

example_en: The cat curled up in a ball on the sofa.
example_zh: 貓在沙發上蜷縮成一團。

example_en: We are having chicken curry for dinner tonight.
example_zh: 我們今晚晚餐要吃咖喱雞。
special_usage: 作為動詞時，'curry favor' 意為「拍馬屁」

example_en: He cursed when he stubbed his toe.
example_zh: 他踢到腳趾時咒罵了一聲。

example_en: She closed the curtains to keep the room dark.
example_zh: 她拉上窗簾讓房間保持黑暗。

example_en: She placed a soft cushion behind her back.
example_zh: 她在背後放了一個柔軟的靠墊。

example_en: It is customary to tip the server in this country.
example_zh: 在這個國家，給小費給服務生是慣例。

example_en: The cyclist wore a helmet for safety.
example_zh: 這位騎自行車的人戴了安全帽以確保安全。

definition_zh: 懷疑的；憤世嫉俗的；冷嘲熱諷的
example_en: He has a cynical view of human nature.
example_zh: 他對人性抱持著一種憤世嫉俗的看法。

example_en: Yellow daffodils bloomed in the garden.
example_zh: 黃色的水仙花在花園中盛開。

example_en: The clothes are still damp from the rain.
example_zh: 衣服因為淋雨還是濕的。

example_en: The dancer moved gracefully across the stage.
example_zh: 那位舞者優雅地在舞台上移動。

example_en: Using a special shampoo can help reduce dandruff.
example_zh: 使用特殊的洗髮精可以幫助減少頭皮屑。

example_en: It was a daring move to quit his job and travel the world.
example_zh: 辭掉工作去環遊世界是個大膽的決定。

definition_zh: 親愛的人；可愛的 (用於稱呼)
example_en: Hello, darling! Did you have a good day?
example_zh: 哈囉，親愛的！今天過得好嗎？
special_usage: 常用作暱稱或對愛人的稱呼。

example_en: He threw a dart and hit the bullseye.
example_zh: 他投出一支飛鏢，正中紅心。

example_en: We set off at daybreak to avoid the heat.
example_zh: 我們在黎明時分出發以避開炎熱。

example_en: The thieves fled under the cover of darkness but were caught in broad daylight.
example_zh: 小偷趁著夜色逃走，但在光天化日之下被抓到了。

example_en: He is responsible for the day-to-day management of the store.
example_zh: 他負責店鋪的日常管理。

example_en: The bright sunlight began to dazzle the drivers.
example_zh: 強烈的陽光開始讓駕駛們目眩。

example_en: The explosion was loud enough to deafen anyone nearby.
example_zh: 爆炸聲大到足以震聾附近的任何人。

example_en: Workers cleared the debris from the road after the storm.
example_zh: 暴風雨過後，工人們清除了路上的碎片。

example_en: Sugar causes our teeth to decay.
example_zh: 糖會導致我們的牙齒蛀牙（腐爛）。

example_en: He tried to deceive the police with a fake story.
example_zh: 他試圖用虛假的故事欺騙警察。

example_en: We need a decisive leader to make a tough choice.
example_zh: 我們需要一位果斷的領導者來做出艱難的選擇。

example_en: We are going to decorate the Christmas tree tonight.
example_zh: 我們今晚要去裝飾聖誕樹。

example_en: The hall is beautiful with its festive decorations.
example_zh: 大廳因節日的裝飾而顯得美麗。

example_en: The government issued a decree to ban plastic bags.
example_zh: 政府頒布了一項禁止塑膠袋的法令。

example_en: She decided to dedicate her life to scientific research.
example_zh: 她決定將一生奉獻給科學研究。

example_en: His success comes from hard work and dedication.
example_zh: 他的成功來自於努力和奉獻。

example_en: From the evidence, we can deduce that he was lying.
example_zh: 根據證據，我們可以推斷他在說謊。

example_en: The company will deduct taxes from your salary.
example_zh: 公司會從你的薪水中扣除稅款。

example_en: You can claim a tax deduction for business expenses.
example_zh: 你可以申請營業費用的稅務扣除額。

example_en: He was recognized for his heroic deeds.
example_zh: 他因英勇的事蹟而受到表揚。

example_en: The judge deemed the evidence insufficient.
example_zh: 法官認為證據不足。

example_en: The mystery continues to deepen.
example_zh: 這個謎團繼續加深。

example_en: There is a manufacturing defect in this car.
example_zh: 這輛車有一個製造瑕疵。

example_en: The team's defender stopped the ball from entering the goal.
example_zh: 球隊的防守員擋住了球進門。

example_en: His actions, though harsh, were defensible under the circumstances.
example_zh: 在這種情況下，他的行為雖然嚴厲，但是可以辯護的。

example_en: He acted in defiance of the rules.
example_zh: 他違抗規定行事。

example_en: The child gave a defiant look to his mother.
example_zh: 那孩子向母親投以違抗的眼神。

example_en: Vitamin deficiency can cause health problems.
example_zh: 維生素缺乏會導致健康問題。

example_en: The diet is deficient in iron.
example_zh: 這種飲食缺乏鐵質。

example_en: I need a definite answer by tomorrow.
example_zh: 我明天之前需要一個明確的答覆。

example_en: This is the definitive edition of the novel.
example_zh: 這是該小說的權威版本。

example_en: The boy defied his parents and stayed out late.
example_zh: 男孩違抗父母親的命令在外逗留很晚。

example_en: The debate degenerated into a shouting match.
example_zh: 辯論退化成了叫罵戰。

example_en: The officer was degraded for disobeying orders.
example_zh: 該軍官因不服從命令而被降級。

example_en: The manager delegated authority to his assistant.
example_zh: 經理將權力委派給他的助理。

definition_zh: 故意的；深思熟慮的；仔細考慮
example_en: He made a deliberate decision to stay out of trouble.
example_zh: 他深思熟慮後決定置身事非之外。

example_en: Be careful with that delicate glass.
example_zh: 小心那個精緻的玻璃杯。

definition_zh: 令人愉快的；討人喜歡的
example_en: We spent a delightful evening by the lake.
example_zh: 我們在湖邊度過了一個愉快的夜晚。

example_en: The government is trying to help juvenile delinquents.
example_zh: 政府正試圖幫助少年犯。
special_usage: 常指欠債未還或未成年罪犯

example_en: The demise of the company shocked everyone.
example_zh: 公司的倒閉震驚了所有人。

example_en: Thousands of demonstrators filled the streets.
example_zh: 成千上萬的示威者擠滿了街道。

example_en: The word 'hot' denotes high temperature.
example_zh: 「Hot」這個詞表示高溫。

example_en: The UN denounced the attack on civilians.
example_zh: 聯合國譴責了對平民的攻擊。

example_en: I have an appointment with the dentist tomorrow.
example_zh: 我明天約了牙醫。

example_en: The train will depart from platform 5.
example_zh: 火車將從 5 號月台出發。

example_en: She works at a department store in the city center.
example_zh: 她在市中心的一家百貨公司工作。

example_en: He is a dependable friend.
example_zh: 他是個值得信賴的朋友。

example_en: The painting depicts a peaceful landscape.
example_zh: 這幅畫描繪了一幅寧靜的風景。

example_en: Overfishing depleted the fish stocks.
example_zh: 過度捕撈耗盡了魚類資源。

example_en: The army was deployed to the border.
example_zh: 軍隊被部署到邊境。

example_en: He was arrested and will be deported.
example_zh: 他被捕並即將被驅逐出境。

example_en: The bad weather really depresses me.
example_zh: 糟糕的天氣讓我真的很沮喪。

example_en: The law deprived them of their rights.
example_zh: 法律剝奪了他們的權利。
special_usage: 常用於被動語態 (be deprived of)

example_en: Most of her income is derived from investments.
example_zh: 她大部分收入來自投資。

example_en: The airplane began to descend.
example_zh: 飛機開始下降。

example_en: He is a direct descendant of the royal family.
example_zh: 他是皇室的直系後裔。

example_en: We began our descent into the valley.
example_zh: 我們開始下降進入山谷。

example_en: The author uses very descriptive language.
example_zh: 這位作者使用了非常具描述性的語言。

example_en: He was designated as the new leader.
example_zh: 他被指定為新領導者。

example_en: He gave up in despair when he failed the test.
example_zh: 他沒通過考試，絕望地放棄了。

example_en: I despise people who are dishonest.
example_zh: 我鄙視不誠實的人。

example_en: We had chocolate cake for dessert.
example_zh: 我們的甜點吃了巧克力蛋糕。

example_en: They were destined for greatness.
example_zh: 他們注定偉大。

example_en: Smoking is destructive to your health.
example_zh: 吸菸對你的健康有破壞性。

example_en: Please detach the bottom part of the form.
example_zh: 請撕下表格的底部。

example_en: She remained detached during the crisis.
example_zh: 她在危機期間保持超然。

example_en: The police detained the suspect for questioning.
example_zh: 警方拘留了嫌疑人進行問話。

example_en: He was held in detention for 24 hours.
example_zh: 他被拘留了24小時。

example_en: The fence was meant to deter trespassers.
example_zh: 柵欄旨在阻止擅自進入者。

example_en: She used a strong detergent to clean the stain.
example_zh: 她用了強力清潔劑來清洗污漬。

example_en: His health began to deteriorate rapidly.
example_zh: 他的健康開始迅速惡化。

example_en: We must prevent the deterioration of the relationship.
example_zh: 我們必須防止關係惡化。

example_en: The central bank decided to devalue the currency.
example_zh: 中央銀行決定讓貨幣貶值。

example_en: The hurricane devastated the coastal town.
example_zh: 颶風摧毀了沿海城鎮。

example_en: The news of his death was devastating.
example_zh: 他去世的消息令人崩潰。

example_en: The plane deviated from its usual flight path.
example_zh: 那架飛機偏離了它平常的飛行路線。

example_en: They devised a plan to increase sales.
example_zh: 他們策劃了一個提高銷量的方案。

example_en: He decided to devote all his free time to studying.
example_zh: 他決定把所有的空閒時間都用來讀書。
special_usage: 常見搭配：devote oneself/time/energy to (致力於...)

example_en: Her devotion to her work is admirable.
example_zh: 她對工作的專注令人敬佩。

definition_zh: 狼吞虎嚥；吞沒；貪婪地閱讀
example_en: The hungry child devoured his dinner.
example_zh: 那個飢餓的孩子狼吞虎嚥地吃完了晚餐。

example_en: The grass was wet with morning dew.
example_zh: 草地因早晨的露水而濕潤。

example_en: The doctor diagnosed the illness as pneumonia.
example_zh: 醫生診斷此疾病為肺炎。
special_usage: 常見搭配：diagnose someone with (被診斷出...)

example_en: He speaks a local dialect of French.
example_zh: 他說一種當地的法語方言。

example_en: Remember to pack enough diapers for the trip.
example_zh: 記得為旅行準備足夠的尿布。

example_en: The manager dictated the letter to his secretary.
example_zh: 經理向秘書口述了那封信。

example_en: We have a spelling dictation every Friday.
example_zh: 我們每週五都有拼寫聽寫測驗。

example_en: The people lived in fear under the cruel dictator.
example_zh: 人民在殘酷的獨裁者統治下恐懼地生活。

example_en: The country transitioned from a dictatorship to a democracy.
example_zh: 該國從獨裁統治轉變為民主制度。

example_en: Can you differentiate between these two species?
example_zh: 你能區分這兩個物種嗎？

example_en: The sun diffuses light and heat.
example_zh: 太陽散發光和熱。
special_usage: 也可作形容詞，指光線柔和的或文章冗長的。

example_en: Milk is hard for some people's digestion.
example_zh: 牛奶對某些人的消化系統來說很難處理。

example_en: He maintained his dignity despite the insults.
example_zh: 儘管受到侮辱，他仍保持著尊嚴。

example_en: She faced the dilemma of choosing between her career and her family.
example_zh: 她面臨著要在事業和家庭之間做選擇的兩難局面。

example_en: Success comes to those who show diligence.
example_zh: 成功屬於那些展現勤奮的人。

example_en: She is a diligent student who always completes her homework.
example_zh: 她是一位勤奮的學生，總是準時完成作業。

example_en: You should dilute the juice with water before drinking.
example_zh: 喝水之前，你應該用水把果汁稀釋一下。

example_en: The coffee costs a dime.
example_zh: 這杯咖啡花了一角硬幣。
special_usage: 常用於口語 'a dime a dozen'（多如牛毛）

example_en: His constant criticism began to diminish her confidence.
example_zh: 他不斷的批評開始削弱她的信心。

example_en: We plan to dine at the new restaurant tonight.
example_zh: 我們計劃今晚去新餐廳用餐。

example_en: The family gathered in the dining room for dinner.
example_zh: 全家人聚集在飯廳吃晚餐。

example_en: Tyrannosaurus Rex is a famous type of dinosaur.
example_zh: 霸王龍是一種著名的恐龍。
special_usage: 常比喻過時的人或事物

example_en: The crisis was resolved through careful diplomacy.
example_zh: 這場危機透過謹慎的外交手段解決了。

example_en: He served as a diplomat in France.
example_zh: 他曾任駐法國的外交官。

example_en: You need to be diplomatic when giving negative feedback.
example_zh: 給負面回饋時需要圓滑一點。

example_en: His lack of experience was a disadvantage.
example_zh: 他缺乏經驗是一項不利條件。

definition_zh: 弱勢的；處於不利地位的
example_en: The program aims to help underprivileged children.
example_zh: 該計畫旨在幫助弱勢兒童。
special_usage: 常指社會經濟地位較低的族群

example_en: There was a disagreement about the budget.
example_zh: 大家對預算意見分歧。

example_en: The sun disappeared behind the clouds.
example_zh: 太陽消失在雲層後面。

example_en: I'm sorry to disappoint you, but I can't come.
example_zh: 很抱歉讓你失望了，但我無法前來。

definition_zh: 失望；令人失望的人或事
example_en: Losing the game was a huge disappointment.
example_zh: 輸掉比賽是個巨大的失望。

example_en: She looked at him with disapproval.
example_zh: 她用不贊成的眼光看著他。

example_en: My parents disapprove of my decision.
example_zh: 我的父母不贊成我的決定。

example_en: The meeting was a disastrous failure.
example_zh: 那場會議是個徹底的失敗。

example_en: He stared in disbelief at the damage.
example_zh: 他難以置信地看著造成的損害。

example_en: Please discard the rubbish.
example_zh: 請丟掉垃圾。

example_en: It was hard to discern the truth.
example_zh: 很難辨別真相。

example_en: Buddha had many disciples.
example_zh: 佛陀有許多門徒。
special_usage: 常指特定宗教或哲學家的追隨者

example_en: She felt discomfort in her stomach after eating.
example_zh: 她吃完後感到胃部不適。

example_en: He decided to disconnect from social media.
example_zh: 他決定斷開與社交媒體的連接。

example_en: Don't let failures discourage you.
example_zh: 不要讓失敗使你氣餒。

example_en: The scandal discredited the politician.
example_zh: 醜聞損害了這位政治家的信譽。

example_en: She was discreet about her personal life.
example_zh: 她對自己的私生活非常謹慎。

example_en: There was a discrepancy in the financial records.
example_zh: 財務記錄中存在不一致。

example_en: It is illegal to discriminate based on race.
example_zh: 基於種族的歧視是違法的。

example_en: His actions brought disgrace to the family.
example_zh: 他的行為給家庭帶來了恥辱。

example_en: His behavior was disgraceful.
example_zh: 他的行為非常可恥。

example_en: He tried to disguise his voice.
example_zh: 他試圖掩飾自己的聲音。

example_en: She looked at him with disgust.
example_zh: 她厭惡地看著他。

example_en: He was dishonest about his intentions.
example_zh: 他對自己的意圖不誠實。

example_en: The old building began to disintegrate.
example_zh: 這座舊建築開始崩潰。

example_en: She dislikes spicy food.
example_zh: 她不喜歡辣的食物。

example_en: They decided to dismantle the old machine.
example_zh: 他們決定拆卸這台舊機器。

example_en: She looked at the mess with dismay.
example_zh: 她驚恐地看著這一團糟。

example_en: The company decided to dismiss him.
example_zh: 公司決定解雇他。

example_en: His dismissal from the job was unexpected.
example_zh: 他被解雇的消息出乎意料。

example_en: This tool is dispensable for the task.
example_zh: 這個工具對這項任務來說是可有可無的。

example_en: The machine dispenses snacks.
example_zh: 這台機器分配零食。

example_en: The crowd began to disperse.
example_zh: 人群開始分散。

example_en: The storm displaced thousands of people.
example_zh: 風暴迫使成千上萬的人流離失所。

example_en: His rude behavior displeased everyone in the room.
example_zh: 他粗魯的行為讓房間裡的每個人都不高興。

example_en: Many restaurants use disposable cutlery.
example_zh: 許多餐廳使用一次性餐具。
special_usage: Disposable income 指可支配所得（扣除稅賦與生活必需品後的收入）。

example_en: We need to dispose of these old files.
example_zh: 我們需要處理掉這些舊檔案。
special_usage: Dispose of 通常是「處置、解決」的意思。

example_en: He disregarded the warning signs and entered the building.
example_zh: 他無視警告標誌，進入了大樓。

example_en: The protest disrupted traffic for hours.
example_zh: 抗議活動讓交通中斷了好幾個小時。

example_en: There is widespread dissatisfaction with the new policy.
example_zh: 大眾對新政策普遍感到不滿。
special_usage: 常與 with 連用 (dissatisfaction with something)。

example_en: The judge expressed his dissent during the ruling.
example_zh: 法官在裁決時表達了他的異議。

definition_zh: 持不同政見者；異議人士
example_en: The political dissident was forced to leave the country.
example_zh: 那位政治異議人士被迫離開該國。

example_en: The wind finally dissipated the dark clouds.
example_zh: 風終於驅散了烏雲。
special_usage: 常指能量、氣體或時間的消散。

example_en: Sugar dissolves quickly in hot water.
example_zh: 糖在熱水中溶解得很快。
special_usage: Dissolve a partnership/company 指解散合夥關係/公司。

example_en: I tried to dissuade him from quitting his job.
example_zh: 我試圖勸阻他不要辭職。
special_usage: 常與 from 連用 (dissuade someone from doing something)。

example_en: The article was distilled from many sources.
example_zh: 這篇文章是從許多來源中提取精華而成的。
special_usage: 常比喻為從大量資訊中提煉出最重要的部分。

example_en: She has a very distinctive voice.
example_zh: 她有一把非常獨特的嗓音。
special_usage: 強調「與眾不同、容易辨識」。

example_en: Can you distinguish between the two twins?
example_zh: 你能分得清那對雙胞胎嗎？
special_usage: Distinguish between A and B；Distinguish oneself 指使自己與眾不同/表現傑出。

example_en: The media was accused of distorting the facts.
example_zh: 媒體被指控歪曲事實。

example_en: Loud noises distract me when I study.
example_zh: 讀書時，巨大的噪音會讓我分心。

example_en: Turn off your phone to avoid distractions.
example_zh: 把手機關機以避免分心。

example_en: The news caused him great distress.
example_zh: 這個消息給他帶來了巨大的痛苦。

example_en: She looked at the stranger with distrust.
example_zh: 她懷疑地看著那個陌生人。
special_usage: 比 skepticism（懷疑）帶有更強的負面情感。

example_en: Please do not disturb the sleeping baby.
example_zh: 請不要打擾熟睡的嬰兒。

example_en: The loud noise from the construction site was a constant disturbance.
example_zh: 工地傳來的巨大噪音是持續的干擾。

example_en: The news report about the accident was very disturbing.
example_zh: 關於那起事故的新聞報導非常令人不安。

example_en: The car slid off the road and into a ditch.
example_zh: 那輛車滑出路面掉進了溝裡。

example_en: The company plans to diversify its product range.
example_zh: 該公司計劃使其產品線多樣化。

example_en: Traffic was moved along a diversion while the bridge was being repaired.
example_zh: 在橋樑維修期間，車輛被改道行駛。

example_en: They had to divert the river to supply water to the town.
example_zh: 他們必須改變河道流向以供應城鎮用水。

example_en: Standing up too quickly made her feel dizzy.
example_zh: 站得太快讓她覺得頭暈。

example_en: We played dodge ball in PE class today.
example_zh: 我們今天體育課玩了躲避球。

example_en: The dolphin jumped out of the water.
example_zh: 海豚躍出了水面。

example_en: One team dominated the entire game.
example_zh: 有一支隊伍主導了整場比賽。

example_en: The farmer loaded the hay onto the donkey.
example_zh: 農夫把乾草裝到驢子背上。

definition_zh: 注定失敗的；命中註定的
example_en: Without help, their expedition was doomed.
example_zh: 沒有援助，他們的探險注定失敗。

example_en: A package was waiting on the doorstep.
example_zh: 有一個包裹在門階上等著。

example_en: He stood in the doorway, blocking the light.
example_zh: 他站在門口，擋住了光線。

example_en: Many students live in the university dormitory.
example_zh: 許多學生住在大學宿舍裡。

definition_zh: 雙十節（中華民國國慶日）
example_en: Double Tenth Day is the national day of the Republic of China.
example_zh: 雙十節是中華民國的國慶日。

example_en: It is doubtful whether he will come on time.
example_zh: 他是否會準時到達令人懷疑。

example_en: She will doubtless win the competition.
example_zh: 她無疑會贏得比賽。

example_en: She kneaded the dough to make bread.
example_zh: 她揉捏生麵團來做麵包。

example_en: I bought a glazed doughnut for breakfast.
example_zh: 我買了一個糖霜甜甜圈當早餐。

example_en: A white dove is often a symbol of peace.
example_zh: 白鴿通常是和平的象徵。

example_en: I heard someone coming downstairs.
example_zh: 我聽到有人正走下樓。

example_en: He gazed downward at his feet.
example_zh: 他低頭注視著自己的腳。

example_en: I started to doze off during the movie.
example_zh: 我看電影時開始打瞌睡。

example_en: Many people eat zongzi during the Dragon Boat Festival.
example_zh: 端午節時許多人會吃粽子。
special_usage: 專有名詞，首字母通常大寫

example_en: A dragonfly landed on the leaf.
example_zh: 一隻蜻蜓停在葉子上。

example_en: She draped the shawl over her shoulders.
example_zh: 她將披肩披在肩上。

example_en: The company made a drastic change to its policy.
example_zh: 公司對其政策做出了劇烈的改變。

example_en: The main drawback of this car is its high price.
example_zh: 這輛車的主要缺點是價格太高。

example_en: Please put the documents in the top drawer.
example_zh: 請把文件放進最上面的抽屜裡。

example_en: I dread going to the dentist.
example_zh: 我很害怕去看牙醫。

example_en: We had a dreadful time at the restaurant.
example_zh: 我們在那家餐廳的經歷糟透了。
special_usage: 口語中可用作加強語氣（如：a dreadful lot of work）

example_en: It was a dreary, rainy day.
example_zh: 那是一個陰沉的下雨天。

example_en: She placed the flowers on the dresser.
example_zh: 她把花放在梳妝檯上。

example_en: The boat started to drift away from the shore.
example_zh: 那艘船開始漂離海岸。

example_en: Water dripped from the ceiling.
example_zh: 水從天花板滴下來。

example_en: You can park your car in the driveway.
example_zh: 你可以把車停在車道上。

example_en: It was only a light drizzle, so we kept walking.
example_zh: 當時只是下著小雨，所以我們繼續走。

example_en: The drought caused a shortage of water.
example_zh: 乾旱導致了水源短缺。

example_en: The loud music drowned out his voice.
example_zh: 嘈雜的音樂蓋過了他的聲音。

example_en: The medicine made me feel drowsy.
example_zh: 這藥讓我感到昏昏欲睡。

example_en: I need to stop by the drugstore to buy some shampoo.
example_zh: 我需要去藥房買一些洗髮精。
special_usage: 美式英語常用，英式英語常用 chemist 或 pharmacy

definition_zh: 給...起綽號；為（電影等）配音
example_en: The media dubbed her 'the Iron Lady'.
example_zh: 媒體給她起了個綽號叫「鐵娘子」。

example_en: I was dubious about his promises.
example_zh: 我對他的承諾持懷疑態度。

example_en: The mother duck was followed by a line of ducklings.
example_zh: 母鴨後面跟著一列小鴨。

definition_zh: 枯燥無味的；遲鈍的；陰沉的
example_en: The lecture was incredibly dull.
example_zh: 那場演講枯燥得令人難以置信。

example_en: We ate steamed dumplings for dinner.
example_zh: 我們晚餐吃了蒸餃。

example_en: The streetlights come on at dusk.
example_zh: 路燈在黃昏時分亮起。

example_en: The old books were covered in dusty covers.
example_zh: 那些舊書的封面布滿灰塵。

example_en: The fairy tale featured a dwarf.
example_zh: 這個童話故事裡有一位侏儒。

example_en: He dwells in a small cabin in the woods.
example_zh: 他居住在森林裡的一間小木屋中。

example_en: They bought a new dwelling in the suburbs.
example_zh: 他們在郊區買了一棟新住宅。

example_en: She used henna to dye her hair red.
example_zh: 她用指甲花把頭髮染紅。

example_en: The miners used dynamite to blast through the rock.
example_zh: 礦工們用炸藥炸開岩石。

example_en: The Ming Dynasty is known for its porcelain.
example_zh: 明朝以其瓷器聞名。

example_en: He is eager to start his new job.
example_zh: 他渴望開始他的新工作。

example_en: She made an earnest attempt to help.
example_zh: 她真心誠意地試圖提供幫助。

example_en: He listens to music with his earphones.
example_zh: 他戴著耳機聽音樂。

example_en: She wore a pair of diamond earrings.
example_zh: 她戴了一對鑽石耳環。

example_en: The tide began to ebb.
example_zh: 潮水開始退去。
special_usage: at a low ebb (處於低潮/衰退期)

example_en: The artist was known for his eccentric habits.
example_zh: 這位藝術家以其古怪的習慣聞名。

example_en: Buying in bulk is more economical.
example_zh: 大量購買比較經濟。

example_en: The economist predicted a recession.
example_zh: 這位經濟學家預測將會出現經濟衰退。

example_en: Pollution is having a devastating effect on the marine ecosystem.
example_zh: 污染正對海洋生態系統造成毀滅性的影響。

example_en: She went into ecstasies over the beautiful painting.
example_zh: 她看著那幅美麗的畫作陷入了狂喜。

example_en: He was ecstatic when he heard the good news.
example_zh: 聽到這個好消息時，他欣喜若狂。
special_usage: 常與介系詞 'about' 或 'at' 連用。

definition_zh: 帶邊的；有邊緣的 / 前進
example_en: The knife had a razor-sharp edge. / The boat edged closer to the shore.
example_zh: 那把刀有著剃刀般鋒利的邊緣。 / 小船緩緩靠近岸邊。
special_usage: 作為動詞時，常指緩慢或謹慎地移動。

example_en: Are these berries edible?
example_zh: 這些漿果可以吃嗎？

example_en: It is the job of the school to educate young people.
example_zh: 學校的職責是教育年輕人。

example_en: We had grilled eel for dinner.
example_zh: 我們晚餐吃了烤鰻魚。

example_en: He let his ego get in the way of making the right decision.
example_zh: 他讓自尊心阻礙了做出正確的決定。

example_en: She has eighteen cousins.
example_zh: 她有十八個表親。

example_en: The temperature dropped to eighty degrees.
example_zh: 氣溫降到了八十度。

example_en: The pilot had to eject from the burning plane.
example_zh: 駕駛員不得不從燃燒的飛機中彈射出來。

definition_zh: 詳盡的；精心製作的 / 詳述
example_en: He made an elaborate excuse for being late. / Could you elaborate on that point?
example_zh: 他為遲到編造了一個精心設計的藉口。 / 你可以詳細說明一下那一點嗎？
special_usage: 作為動詞常與介系詞 'on' 或 'upon' 連用。

example_en: Three hours elapsed before the prisoner was found.
example_zh: 三個小時過去了，那名囚犯才被找到。
special_usage: 正式用語，通常用於指時間。

example_en: My schedule is fairly elastic, so I can meet you anytime.
example_zh: 我的行程相當有彈性，所以我隨時都能見你。

example_en: He nudged me with his elbow. / She elbowed her way through the crowd.
example_zh: 他用胳膊肘輕推了我一下。 / 她用胳膊肘擠過人群。

example_en: The electorate is becoming more disillusioned with politics.
example_zh: 全體選民對政治變得愈加失望。
special_usage: 集合名詞，可視為單數或複數。

example_en: We called an electrician to fix the wiring.
example_zh: 我們叫了一位電工來修理線路。

example_en: My daughter is in elementary school.
example_zh: 我的女兒在上小學。
special_usage: 美式英語常用，英式英語常用 primary school。

example_en: He was elevated to the position of manager.
example_zh: 他被提升為經理。

example_en: They built the house on an elevated piece of land.
example_zh: 他們在一塊高地的平地上蓋了房子。

example_en: Take the elevator to the third floor.
example_zh: 搭電梯到三樓。
special_usage: 美式用語；英式稱為 lift。

example_en: The detective tried to elicit a confession from the suspect.
example_zh: 偵探試圖從嫌疑犯口中套出供詞。

example_en: Her eloquence moved the audience to tears.
example_zh: 她的口才感動得聽眾落淚。

definition_zh: 雄辯的，有口才的，傳神的
example_en: His silence was more eloquent than any words.
example_zh: 他的沉默比任何言語更有力。

example_en: The government imposed an arms embargo on the country.
example_zh: 政府對該國實施了武器禁運。
special_usage: 作動詞時意為「禁止（貿易）」。

example_en: We embarked on a new business venture last year.
example_zh: 我們去年開始了一項新的商業投資。
special_usage: 常用搭配：embark on/upon (開始從事)

example_en: Don't try to embarrass him in front of his friends.
example_zh: 不要在朋友面前讓他難堪。

definition_zh: 尷尬，窘迫；令人尷尬的人/事
example_en: Forgetting his name was a major embarrassment.
example_zh: 忘記他的名字是一件非常尷尬的事。

example_en: The journalist was embedded with the troops.
example_zh: 這名記者隨軍隊進行嵌入式採訪。

example_en: She embodies the spirit of the organization.
example_zh: 她體現了該組織的精神。

example_en: The company embraced the new technology.
example_zh: 該公司欣然接受了這項新技術。

example_en: The plans for the new school are still in embryo.
example_zh: 新學校的計劃尚在萌芽階段。

example_en: She emerged from the sea, dripping wet.
example_zh: 她從海裡浮出來，全身濕透。

example_en: The emergence of the internet changed the world.
example_zh: 互聯網的出現改變了世界。

definition_zh: 移居國外者（指離開本國的人）
example_en: There was a wave of emigrants leaving the country.
example_zh: 出現了一波離開該國的移民潮。
special_usage: 與 immigrant（移民入境者）相對。

example_en: He decided to emigrate to Canada for better opportunities.
example_zh: 為了更好的機會，他決定移居加拿大。
special_usage: Emigrate from A to B (從A移民到B)

example_en: The economic crisis led to a rise in emigration.
example_zh: 經濟危機導致移民海外的人數增加。

example_en: The machine emits a high-pitched sound.
example_zh: 這台機器發出一種高音頻的聲音。

example_en: Love, anger, and fear are all strong emotions.
example_zh: 愛、憤怒和恐懼都是強烈的情緒。

example_en: He emphasized the importance of teamwork.
example_zh: 他強調了團隊合作的重要性。

example_en: She was emphatic that she would not resign.
example_zh: 她斷然表示不會辭職。

example_en: Congress enacted the new law last week.
example_zh: 國會上週通過了這項新法律。

example_en: I will enclose your letter with mine.
example_zh: 我會把你的信附在我的信裡。

example_en: She gave me the encouragement to keep going.
example_zh: 她給了我繼續下去的鼓勵。

example_en: Pollution endangers the survival of many species.
example_zh: 污染危及許多物種的生存。

example_en: We will endeavor to finish the project on time.
example_zh: 我們會努力按時完成專案。

example_en: The celebrity endorsed the new product.
example_zh: 那位名人代言了這項新產品。

example_en: He endowed the university with a large sum of money.
example_zh: 他向大學捐贈了一大筆錢。
special_usage: 常見搭配 'be endowed with'（天生賦有）。

example_en: She has a natural endowment for music.
example_zh: 她有音樂天賦。

example_en: Marathon runners need great endurance.
example_zh: 馬拉松跑者需要極大的耐力。

example_en: I cannot endure this noise any longer.
example_zh: 我再也無法忍受這噪音了。

example_en: The dog is very energetic in the morning.
example_zh: 這隻狗早上精力非常充沛。

example_en: A good breakfast energizes you for the day.
example_zh: 一頓豐盛的早餐能給你一天的能量。

example_en: The police are there to enforce the law.
example_zh: 警察在那裡是為了執法。

example_en: We had an enjoyable evening at the party.
example_zh: 我們在派對上度過了一個愉快的夜晚。

example_en: I get a lot of enjoyment from reading.
example_zh: 我從閱讀中獲得很多樂趣。

example_en: Can you enlighten me on this issue?
example_zh: 你能就這個問題指點我嗎？

example_en: Travel enriches our life experience.
example_zh: 旅行豐富了我們的人生閱歷。

example_en: I plan to enroll in the art class.
example_zh: 我計劃報名參加美術課。

example_en: A debate ensued after his speech.
example_zh: 他演講後隨即發生了一場辯論。

example_en: The job entails a lot of hard work.
example_zh: 這份工作需要非常努力。

example_en: The magician entertained the children.
example_zh: 魔術師娛樂了孩子們。

example_en: He is a talented entertainer.
example_zh: 他是一位很有才華的藝人。

example_en: He has a lot of enthusiasm for learning new things.
example_zh: 他對學習新事物充滿熱情。

example_en: He is a photography enthusiast.
example_zh: 他是一位攝影愛好者。

example_en: She was very enthusiastic about the project.
example_zh: 她對這個項目非常熱情。

example_en: This ticket entitles you to a free drink.
example_zh: 這張票賦予你免費飲料的權利。
special_usage: be entitled to (有資格/權利獲得)

example_en: She was envious of her sister's success.
example_zh: 她嫉妒她姐姐的成功。

example_en: The environmentalist campaigned against pollution.
example_zh: 這位環保主義者發起運動反對污染。

example_en: It is difficult to envisage the future.
example_zh: 很難設想未來。

example_en: The president sent an envoy to negotiate.
example_zh: 總統派了一位特使去談判。

example_en: I envy your ability to speak multiple languages.
example_zh: 我羨慕你說多種語言的能力。

example_en: The government is trying to control the spread of the epidemic.
example_zh: 政府正試圖控制流行病的傳播。

example_en: The invention of the computer marked a new epoch in history.
example_zh: 電腦的發明標誌著歷史上的新紀元。

example_en: You shouldn't equate wealth with happiness.
example_zh: 你不應該把財富與幸福畫上等號。

example_en: Singapore is located very close to the equator.
example_zh: 新加坡位於非常接近赤道的地方。

example_en: We need to equip the lab with new computers.
example_zh: 我們需要用新電腦裝備實驗室。

example_en: Please erase the wrong answer.
example_zh: 請擦掉錯誤的答案。

example_en: Can I borrow your eraser?
example_zh: 我可以借你的橡皮擦嗎？

example_en: They plan to erect a statue in the square.
example_zh: 他們計劃在廣場上建立一座雕像。

example_en: Wind and water erode the rocks over time.
example_zh: 風和水隨著時間侵蝕岩石。

example_en: Soil erosion is a serious environmental problem.
example_zh: 土壤侵蝕是一個嚴重的環境問題。

example_en: I have to run an errand to the post office.
example_zh: 我得去郵局跑一趟。

example_en: The report contained erroneous information.
example_zh: 這份報告包含錯誤的資訊。

example_en: The volcano may erupt at any time.
example_zh: 火山隨時可能爆發。

example_en: The eruption of the volcano caused widespread damage.
example_zh: 火山的噴發造成了廣泛的破壞。

example_en: The conflict could escalate into a full-scale war.
example_zh: 衝突可能會升級為全面戰爭。

example_en: She took the escalator to the second floor.
example_zh: 她乘電扶梯到二樓。

example_en: He is held in high esteem by his colleagues.
example_zh: 他受到同事的高度尊重。

example_en: She bought fruits, vegetables, etc.
example_zh: 她買了水果、蔬菜等等。

example_en: They promised to love each other for eternity.
example_zh: 他們承諾永遠愛對方。

example_en: Medical ethics are crucial in healthcare.
example_zh: 醫療倫理在醫療保健中至關重要。

example_en: The building was evacuated due to the fire.
example_zh: 由於火災，大樓被疏散了。

example_en: The evacuation plan was executed smoothly.
example_zh: 疏散計劃執行得很順利。

example_en: The water evaporated quickly in the heat.
example_zh: 水在高溫下迅速蒸發了。

example_en: Evaporation is a key part of the water cycle.
example_zh: 蒸發是水循環的關鍵部分。

example_en: The eventual outcome was a success.
example_zh: 最終的結果是成功的。

example_en: Pine trees are evergreen.
example_zh: 松樹是常綠的。

example_en: The song evoked memories of her childhood.
example_zh: 這首歌喚起了她對童年的回憶。

example_en: Species evolve over millions of years.
example_zh: 物種經過數百萬年進化。

example_en: He tends to exaggerate the truth.
example_zh: 他傾向於誇大事實。

example_en: Her story was full of exaggeration.
example_zh: 她的故事充滿了誇張。

example_en: The examinees were nervous before the test.
example_zh: 考生在考試前很緊張。

example_en: The examiner graded the papers carefully.
example_zh: 主考官仔細批改試卷。

example_en: She was exceedingly happy with the results.
example_zh: 她對結果非常滿意。

example_en: The news will surely excite everyone.
example_zh: 這則消息肯定會讓 everyone 興奮。

example_en: She exclaimed in surprise at the sight.
example_zh: 她看到那景象時驚訝地大叫。

example_en: We went on an excursion to the mountains.
example_zh: 我們去山裡做了一次短途旅行。

example_en: His behavior exemplifies courage.
example_zh: 他的行為體現了勇氣。

example_en: You need to exert more effort to succeed.
example_zh: 你需要付出更多努力才能成功。

example_en: He lived in exile for ten years.
example_zh: 他在流亡中生活了十年。

example_en: There is a general expectation of rain.
example_zh: 大家普遍預料會下雨。
special_usage: meet one's expectations (符合某人的期望)

example_en: They organized an expedition to the North Pole.
example_zh: 他們組織了一次去北極的探險。

example_en: The student was expelled for cheating.
example_zh: 那名學生因作弊被開除。

example_en: Don't expend all your energy at once.
example_zh: 不要一下子耗盡你所有的精力。
special_usage: expend time/money on (在…上花費時間/金錢)

example_en: My passport will expire next month.
example_zh: 我的護照下個月就要到期了。

example_en: The bomb was about to explode.
example_zh: 炸彈快要爆炸了。

example_en: We should exploit our natural resources wisely.
example_zh: 我們應該明智地利用自然資源。

example_en: The situation is highly explosive.
example_zh: 局勢一觸即發。

example_en: Don't expose your skin to the sun too long.
example_zh: 不要讓皮膚在陽光下曝曬太久。

example_en: The fair is a major industrial exposition.
example_zh: 這場展銷會是一場大型的工業博覽會。

definition_zh: 富於表情的；有表現力的
example_en: Her eyes are very expressive.
example_zh: 她的眼睛非常富有表現力。

example_en: His expulsion from school was a shock.
example_zh: 他被學校開除令人震驚。

example_en: She wore an exquisite diamond necklace.
example_zh: 她戴著一條精緻的鑽石項鍊。

example_en: He cares too much about externals.
example_zh: 他太注重外表了。

example_en: Dinosaurs have been extinct for millions of years.
example_zh: 恐龍已經滅絕數百萬年了。

example_en: Firefighters worked tirelessly to extinguish the blaze.
example_zh: 消防員不知疲倦地工作以撲滅大火。

example_en: She participates in several extracurricular activities, including chess and swimming.
example_zh: 她參加了幾項課外活動，包括西洋棋和游泳。

example_en: The country refused to extradite the fugitive to the neighboring nation.
example_zh: 該國拒絕將逃犯引渡給鄰國。

example_en: They threw an extravagant party for their daughter's graduation.
example_zh: 他們為女兒的畢業典禮舉辦了一場奢華的派對。

example_en: The government is taking steps to combat political extremists.
example_zh: 政府正在採取措施打擊政治極端分子。

example_en: He raised his eyebrow in disbelief when he heard the news.
example_zh: 聽到這則消息時，他懷疑地挑起了眉毛。

example_en: She batted her eyelashes at him flirtatiously.
example_zh: 她向他調情似地眨了眨睫毛。

example_en: She closed her eyelids and took a deep breath to calm her nerves.
example_zh: 她閉上眼皮，深吸一口氣以平復緊張的情緒。

example_en: Wearing glasses has significantly improved my eyesight.
example_zh: 戴眼鏡大大改善了我的視力。

example_en: Aesop's Fables teach moral lessons through simple stories.
example_zh: 伊索寓言透過簡單的故事傳授道德教訓。

example_en: He was accused of fabricating evidence to mislead the jury.
example_zh: 他被指控捏造證據以誤導陪審團。

example_en: The book explores every facet of the complex historical event.
example_zh: 這本書探討了這起複雜歷史事件的方方面面。

example_en: The political party was divided into opposing factions.
example_zh: 該政黨分裂為對立的派系。

example_en: That toy was just a passing fad among children.
example_zh: 那個玩具只是孩子們中間一時的狂熱。

example_en: The colour of the curtains will fade if exposed to direct sunlight.
example_zh: 窗簾如果暴露在陽光直射下會褪色。

example_en: The weather forecast predicted a high of 85 degrees Fahrenheit.
example_zh: 天氣預報預測最高氣溫為華氏85度。

example_en: There was a faint smell of jasmine in the air.
example_zh: 空氣中有一絲微弱的茉莉花香。

example_en: He has always been a faithful supporter of the local football team.
example_zh: 他一直以來都是該本地足球隊的忠實支持者。

example_en: His voice began to falter as he spoke about his tragic past.
example_zh: 當談到自己悲慘的過去時，他的聲音開始顫抖支吾。

example_en: His familiarity with the software made him the obvious choice for the job.
example_zh: 他對該軟體的熟悉使他成為該職位的不二之選。

example_en: The drought led to a severe famine that affected millions of people.
example_zh: 乾旱導致了影響數百萬人的嚴重饑荒。

example_en: She waved a final farewell to her friends.
example_zh: 她向朋友們揮手做最後的告別。
special_usage: 通常用於正式或永久性的離別。

example_en: The magician's tricks fascinated the children.
example_zh: 魔術師的把戲讓孩子們非常著迷。

example_en: He has a lifelong fascination with ancient history.
example_zh: 他對古代歷史有著畢生的迷戀。

example_en: Short skirts are fashionable again this year.
example_zh: 短裙今年又開始流行了。

example_en: Please fasten your seatbelt before takeoff.
example_zh: 起飛前請繫好您的安全帶。

example_en: The soldiers were suffering from extreme fatigue.
example_zh: 士兵們正遭受極度的疲勞。
special_usage: 也可作為形容詞用於工程學，指「金屬疲勞」。

example_en: Turn off the faucet to save water.
example_zh: 關掉水龍頭以節約用水。
special_usage: 主要用於美式英語，英式英語常用 tap。

example_en: The faulty wiring caused the fire.
example_zh: 有缺陷的線路引發了火災。

definition_zh: 贊成的；有利的；討人喜歡的
example_en: The weather conditions were favorable for sailing.
example_zh: 天氣狀況對航行很有利。

example_en: He was fearful of losing his job.
example_zh: 他很害怕失去工作。

example_en: Your plan sounds economically feasible.
example_zh: 你的計劃在經濟上聽起來可行。

definition_zh: 盛宴；宴會 (名)；盡情享用 (動)
example_en: The wedding feast lasted all night.
example_zh: 婚宴持續了一整晚。
special_usage: 常用片語 a feast for the eyes (視覺盛宴)。

example_en: The bird preened its feathers.
example_zh: 那隻鳥梳理著它的羽毛。
special_usage: Birds of a feather flock together (物以類聚)。

example_en: She made a feeble attempt to smile.
example_zh: 她勉強擠出一絲無力的微笑。

example_en: We bought a bird feeder for the garden.
example_zh: 我們為花園買了一個鳥類餵食器。
special_usage: 常指鐵路或公路的支線 (feeder line)。

definition_zh: 女性的；陰柔的；女子氣的
example_en: She has a very feminine style of dress.
example_zh: 她的穿著風格非常具有女人味。

definition_zh: 女權主義；男女平等主義
example_en: Modern feminism advocates for equal rights.
example_zh: 現代女權主義倡導平等權利。

example_en: She identifies as a feminist.
example_zh: 她自認為是一名女權主義者。

definition_zh: 肥沃的；多產的；富創造力的
example_en: The land is fertile and ideal for farming.
example_zh: 這片土地很肥沃，是耕種的理想之地。

example_en: The soil's fertility makes it good for growing crops.
example_zh: 土壤的肥沃使其適合種植農作物。
special_usage: 常見於 fertility rate (生育率)。

example_en: Farmers use fertilizer to help crops grow.
example_zh: 農民使用肥料來幫助農作物生長。

example_en: Could you go upstairs and fetch my glasses?
example_zh: 你能上樓去把我的眼鏡拿來嗎？

example_en: She introduced her fiancé to the family.
example_zh: 她把她的未婚夫介紹給家人。
special_usage: 源自法語，通常指已訂婚的男性伴侶。

definition_zh: 小提琴；(非正式)弄虛作假；(用手)玩弄
example_en: He fiddled with the settings on the radio until he found the station.
example_zh: 他擺弄著收音機的調鈕，直到找到電台為止。
special_usage: Play the fiddle 指拉小提琴；Fiddle around 指虛度光陰或瞎搞。

example_en: The stereo system boasts high-fidelity sound.
example_zh: 這套立體聲音響具有高保真音效。
special_usage: 常見於形容音響設備的保真度 (High fidelity)，或形容夫妻間的忠貞。

example_en: The competition among the brands is fierce.
example_zh: 品牌之間的競爭非常激烈。

example_en: The children set off firecrackers to celebrate the New Year.
example_zh: 孩子們點燃鞭炮來慶祝新年。

example_en: Firefighters rushed to the scene of the blaze.
example_zh: 消防員趕到了火災現場。

example_en: Important documents should be kept in a fireproof safe.
example_zh: 重要文件應保存在防火保險箱中。

example_en: The festival ended with a spectacular fireworks display.
example_zh: 節日以一場壯觀的煙火表演畫下句點。
special_usage: 通常以複數形式 Fireworks 出現。

definition_zh: 第一流的；頭等的；非常好
example_en: She traveled to Paris in first-class comfort.
example_zh: 她以頭等艙的舒適度前往巴黎。
special_usage: 可用於形容火車、飛機的艙等，或形容某事物極佳。

example_en: The fisherman cast his net into the sea.
example_zh: 漁夫把網撒進海裡。

example_en: The government is taking steps to protect the local fisheries.
example_zh: 政府正在採取措施保護當地漁場。
special_usage: 指捕魚的行業或特定的捕魚區域。

example_en: The store sells light fixtures and hardware.
example_zh: 這家店出售燈具和五金。
special_usage: 在體育術語中，指預定的比賽日期或對戰組合。

definition_zh: 薄片；碎屑；(非正式)古怪的人；剝落
example_en: Snowflakes were falling gently outside the window.
example_zh: 窗外飄著輕柔的雪花。
special_usage: As a flake 可指不可靠或健忘的人。

example_en: The king was protected by soldiers on his flank.
example_zh: 國王受到側翼士兵的保護。
special_usage: 軍事戰術常用詞，指側面包抄。

definition_zh: 拍打；振(翅)；(布料等的)垂下物
example_en: The bird flapped its wings and flew away.
example_zh: 那隻鳥拍動翅膀飛走了。

example_en: Tempers flared during the heated debate.
example_zh: 在激烈的辯論中，脾氣爆發了。
special_usage: Flare up 通常指突然發怒或暴力升級。

example_en: He used a flashlight to find his keys in the dark.
example_zh: 他在黑暗中用手電筒找鑰匙。

example_en: We had to call for help because we had a flat tire.
example_zh: 因為爆胎了，我們不得不打電話求助。
special_usage: 美式說 Have a flat tire，英式口語常說 Get a puncture。

definition_zh: 奉承；使高興；(衣物)顯得更合身
example_en: You flatter me with such praise.
example_zh: 您這樣稱讚真是太過獎了。
special_usage: Flattery 詞義略帶貶義（甜言蜜語），但 I'm flattered 表示感到榮幸或受寵若驚。

example_en: There is a major flaw in his argument.
example_zh: 他的論點有一個重大缺陷。

example_en: The dog is scratching because it has a flea.
example_zh: 那隻狗在抓癢，因為牠有跳蚤。

example_en: The villagers had to flee the war-torn country.
example_zh: 村民們不得不逃離那個飽受戰爭蹂躪的國家。

example_en: He flicked the dust off his jacket.
example_zh: 他輕彈掉夾克上的灰塵。

example_en: The candlelight flickered in the dark room.
example_zh: 燭光在黑暗的房間裡搖曳。

example_en: She flung the ball to her friend across the field.
example_zh: 她把球扔給球場另一端的朋友。

example_en: A flock of sheep was grazing on the hill.
example_zh: 一群羊在山坡上吃草。

example_en: Heavy rain caused flooding in the city streets.
example_zh: 大雨導致城市街道洪水泛濫。

example_en: He flopped down onto the sofa, exhausted.
example_zh: 他筋疲力盡地跌坐在沙發上。

example_en: He floundered in the deep water, struggling to stay afloat.
example_zh: 他在深水中掙扎，努力保持漂浮。

example_en: Business is flourishing since they expanded their services.
example_zh: 自從擴大服務範圍後，生意蒸蒸日上。

example_en: Prices tend to fluctuate depending on the season.
example_zh: 價格往往會隨著季節波動。

example_en: She speaks English with great fluency.
example_zh: 她英語說得很流利。

example_en: He is a fluent speaker of three languages.
example_zh: 他能流利地說三種語言。

example_en: He is afraid he will flunk the math test.
example_zh: 他擔心自己數學考試會不及格。
special_usage: 常作 flunk out，指因成績不及格而退學。

example_en: She has been taking flute lessons for two years.
example_zh: 她學長笛已經兩年了。

example_en: The bird fluttered its wings and flew away.
example_zh: 那隻鳥拍動翅膀飛走了。

example_en: They fought bravely against their foe.
example_zh: 他們勇敢地與敵人戰鬥。

example_en: It's very foggy this morning, drive carefully.
example_zh: 今早霧很大，開車小心點。

example_en: Cover the dish with aluminum foil.
example_zh: 用鋁箔蓋住這道菜。

example_en: He studied the folklore of the indigenous people.
example_zh: 他研究了原住民的民間傳說。

example_en: The celebrity has millions of followers on social media.
example_zh: 這位名人在社交媒體上有數百萬粉絲。

example_en: The doctor scheduled a follow-up appointment for next week.
example_zh: 醫生約了下星期進行跟進檢查。
special_usage: 亦可作形容詞使用，如 follow-up call (跟進電話)

example_en: She is fond of collecting vintage stamps.
example_zh: 她喜愛收集舊式郵票。
special_usage: 常搭配介系詞 of 使用 (be fond of)

example_en: It was foolish to drive without a seatbelt.
example_zh: 不繫安全帶駕駛是愚蠢的行為。

example_en: I heard footsteps approaching the door.
example_zh: 我聽到有人走向門口的腳步聲。
special_usage: 常以複數形式 footstep 出現

example_en: The rules forbid smoking in this area.
example_zh: 規則禁止在此區域吸煙。
special_usage: 過去式為 forbade，過去分詞為 forbidden

example_en: He wiped the sweat from his forehead.
example_zh: 他擦去額頭上的汗水。

example_en: The language barrier was difficult for the foreigner.
example_zh: 語言障礙對那位外國人來說很困難。

example_en: He is the foremost expert in marine biology.
example_zh: 他是海洋生物學領域最傑出的專家。
special_usage: 常與 first and foremost (首先) 連用

example_en: Nobody could foresee the consequences.
example_zh: 沒有人能預知後果。
special_usage: 過去式 foresaw，過去分詞 foreseen

example_en: My grandfather is getting forgetful in his old age.
example_zh: 我的祖父年紀大了變得越來越健忘。
special_usage: 常指人；指事物應改用 forgettable (容易被忘記的)

example_en: I will never forgive him for what he did.
example_zh: 我永遠不會原諒他所做的事。
special_usage: 過去式 forgave，過去分詞 forgiven

definition_zh: 可怕的；難對付的；令人敬畏的
example_en: The team faced formidable opposition in the finals.
example_zh: 該隊在決賽中遭遇強大的對手。
special_usage: 可用於形容實力、外觀或任務的艱難

example_en: The committee is trying to formulate a new policy.
example_zh: 委員會正試圖制定一項新政策。

example_en: He would never forsake his principles.
example_zh: 他絕不會背棄自己的原則。
special_usage: 過去式 forsook，過去分詞 forsaken；語氣較重，偏向文學或宗教用語

example_en: The forthcoming elections will be very competitive.
example_zh: 即將到來的選舉將會非常競爭。
special_usage: 亦可作名詞，指即將發生的事 (the forthcoming)

example_en: They fortified the castle against attack.
example_zh: 他們加固城堡以抵禦攻擊。
special_usage: 食品強化常說 fortified food

example_en: I'm going on holiday for a fortnight.
example_zh: 我要去度假兩週。
special_usage: 主要在英式英語中使用；美式英語較少用

example_en: We were fortunate to find a parking space so quickly.
example_zh: 我們很幸運這麼快就找到了停車位。
special_usage: 常與 in + 動名詞連用 (fortunate in doing)

example_en: There are fourteen students in the class.
example_zh: 班上有十四位學生。

example_en: The farm raises chickens and ducks as fowl.
example_zh: 農場飼養雞和鴨作為家禽。
special_usage: 通常指作為食物的禽類，有時也泛指鳥類

example_en: He suffered a fracture in his left leg.
example_zh: 他的左腿遭遇了骨折。
special_usage: 作動詞時亦可用於比喻，如 relationship fractured (關係破裂)

example_en: Handle with care, the glass is fragile.
example_zh: 小心拿放，這玻璃很脆弱。

example_en: We found a fragment of the broken vase on the floor.
example_zh: 我們在地板上發現了花瓶的一片碎片。

example_en: The garden was filled with fragrant roses.
example_zh: 花園裡充滿了芬芳的玫瑰。

example_en: The old man was frail and needed a walking stick.
example_zh: 那位老人身體虛弱，需要拄拐杖。

example_en: The souvenir cost twenty francs.
example_zh: 這紀念品花了二十法郎。

example_en: He was frantic with worry when his son didn't come home.
example_zh: 當他兒子沒回家時，他焦慮得發狂。

example_en: She is a fitness freak and goes to the gym every day.
example_zh: 她是個健身狂，每天都去健身房。
special_usage: 亦作動詞：freak out (使)驚慌失措

example_en: The freeway was jammed with traffic during rush hour.
example_zh: 高峰時間高速公路上塞滿了車。

example_en: Put the meat in the freezer to keep it fresh.
example_zh: 把肉放進冷藏庫以保持新鮮。

example_en: It's freezing outside, so wear a heavy coat.
example_zh: 外面冷得要命，所以穿件厚外套吧。
special_usage: 亦作名詞：freezing point 冰點

example_en: I ordered a burger with a side of french fries.
example_zh: 我點了一個漢堡和一份炸薯條。

example_en: As a freshman, he was nervous about his first day of college.
example_zh: 作為大一新生，他對大學第一天感到緊張。
special_usage: 指男女通用，現常用 first-year student 替代

example_en: Don't fret over small details.
example_zh: 不要為小事煩惱。

example_en: There is a lot of friction between the two managers.
example_zh: 這兩位經理之間有很多摩擦。

example_en: The loud noise gave me a fright.
example_zh: 那巨大的聲響嚇了我一跳。

example_en: The thunder frightened the little dog.
example_zh: 雷聲嚇到了那隻小狗。

example_en: She brushed her fringe out of her eyes.
example_zh: 她把劉海從眼睛上撥開。
special_usage: 亦作形容詞：fringe benefits 額外福利

example_en: The kids were playing catch with a frisbee in the park.
example_zh: 孩子們在公園裡玩飛盤接球。

example_en: The scandal was a front-page news story.
example_zh: 這件醜聞是頭版新聞。

example_en: The morning was cold and frosty.
example_zh: 早晨寒冷且結霜。

example_en: She frowned when she saw the messy room.
example_zh: 她看到凌亂的房間時皺起了眉頭。
special_usage: 搭配介詞 at 或 on

example_en: It was a fruitful discussion that led to a great idea.
example_zh: 這是一次富有成效的討論，促成了一個好主意。

example_en: The traffic jam frustrated him and made him late.
example_zh: 交通阻塞使他感到沮喪，並讓他遲到了。

example_en: He let out a sigh of frustration.
example_zh: 他嘆了一口氣，充滿了挫折感。

example_en: I like to fry eggs for breakfast.
example_zh: 我喜歡早餐時煎蛋。

example_en: She worked hard to fulfill her dream.
example_zh: 她努力工作以實現她的夢想。

example_en: He is looking for a full-time job.
example_zh: 他正在尋找一份全職工作。
special_usage: 亦可作副詞使用 (e.g., work full-time)

definition_zh: 煙霧；氣體 (通常指刺鼻的)
example_en: The fumes from the car exhaust are harmful.
example_zh: 汽車廢氣的煙霧是有害的。

example_en: Don't breathe in the chemical fumes.
example_zh: 不要吸入化學煙霧。
special_usage: 通常指有毒或刺鼻的氣體
