example_zh: 他的英勇行為拯救了許多生命。

example_en: The police seized a large shipment of heroin.
example_zh: 警方查獲了一大批海洛因。

example_en: She is the heroine of the novel.
example_zh: 她是這部小說的女主角。

example_en: The red car is hers.
example_zh: 那輛紅色轎車是她的。

example_en: Don't hesitate to contact me if you need help.
example_zh: 如果需要幫助，請隨時聯絡我。

example_en: She accepted the offer without hesitation.
example_zh: 她毫不猶豫地接受了提議。

example_en: Most people are heterosexual.
example_zh: 大多數人是異性戀。

example_en: They live in a high-rise apartment building.
example_zh: 他們住在一棟高層公寓大樓裡。

example_en: Terrorists attempted to hijack the plane.
example_zh: 恐怖分子試圖劫持那架飛機。

definition_zh: 劫持者（尤指劫持交通工具）
example_en: The police successfully negotiated with the hijacker.
example_zh: 警方成功與劫持者進行了談判。

definition_zh: （動）徒步旅行；（名）遠足；（數量）增加
example_en: We plan to hike in the mountains this weekend.
example_zh: 我們計劃這個週末去山裡徒步旅行。
special_usage: 作名詞時也可指價格或數量的大幅上漲（e.g., a price hike）

example_en: The lost hiker was rescued by the search team.
example_zh: 迷路的徒步旅行者被搜救隊救出了。

example_en: Wildflowers covered the hillside in spring.
example_zh: 春天時，山坡上開滿了野花。

example_en: The heavy rain hindered our progress.
example_zh: 大雨阻礙了我們的進度。

example_en: The door squeaks because the hinge needs oil.
example_zh: 門發出嘎吱聲是因為鉸鏈需要潤滑。
special_usage: 作動詞時常與 on 連用，表示「取決於」

example_en: The hippopotamus is a large, mostly aquatic mammal.
example_zh: 河馬是一種大型的、大部分時間在水中的哺乳動物。

example_en: The snake will hiss when it feels threatened.
example_zh: 蛇在感到威脅時會發出嘶嘶聲。
special_usage: 也可指發出不滿的噓聲

example_en: The historian studied ancient manuscripts.
example_zh: 這位歷史學家研究古代手稿。

example_en: The bees returned to the hive with nectar.
example_zh: 蜜蜂帶著花蜜回到了蜂巢。

example_en: My throat is sore and my voice is hoarse.
example_zh: 我的喉嚨痛，聲音也啞了。

example_en: She felt homesick during her first year at college.
example_zh: 她在大學第一年感到非常想家。
special_usage: 名詞形式為 homesickness (思鄉病)

example_en: The population of the village is relatively homogeneous.
example_zh: 這個村莊的人口相對同質。

example_en: He is an advocate for homosexual rights.
example_zh: 他是同性戀權益的倡導者。
special_usage: 較正式或委婉的說法是 gay 或 lesbian

definition_zh: 誠實地；實在地（用於加強語氣）
example_en: Honestly, I don't think that's a good idea.
example_zh: 老實說，我認為那不是個好主意。
special_usage: 常作為插入語，用於表達個人真實看法

example_en: Honesty is the best policy.
example_zh: 誠實為上策（老實總是上策）。

example_en: They went to Hawaii for their honeymoon.
example_zh: 他們去夏威夷度蜜月。
special_usage: 亦可比喻指一段短暫的和諧時期（e.g., honeymoon period）

example_en: Hong Kong is known as the Pearl of the Orient.
example_zh: 香港被譽為東方之珠。

example_en: Don't honk your horn in a residential area.
example_zh: 不要在住宅區按喇叭。

definition_zh: 可敬的；榮譽的；（用於稱呼）尊敬的
example_en: He is an honorable man who keeps his promises.
example_zh: 他是個信守承諾的可敬之人。
special_usage: 美式拼寫為 honorable，英式常見拼寫為 honourable

example_en: She was awarded an honorary degree.
example_zh: 她被授予了名譽學位。
special_usage: 指頭銜或學位是為了表揚而非通過常規學業獲得

example_en: The horse injured its hoof on the rocks.
example_zh: 那匹馬在岩石上弄傷了蹄。

example_en: She felt hopeful about the results of the experiment.
example_zh: 她對實驗的結果感到充滿希望。

example_en: Without a map, finding the way seemed hopeless.
example_zh: 沒有地圖，似乎沒有希望找到路。

example_en: The news of the disaster will horrify the public.
example_zh: 災難的消息將使公眾感到驚恐。

example_en: This engine has over 300 horsepower.
example_zh: 這台引擎擁有超過300匹馬力。

example_en: The locals were very hospitable to the tourists.
example_zh: 當地人對遊客非常熱情好客。

example_en: He was hospitalized for a severe infection.
example_zh: 他因嚴重感染而住院治療。

example_en: The gunman held three people hostage.
example_zh: 持槍歹徒劫持了三名人質。

example_en: The hostess welcomed us at the door.
example_zh: 女主人在門口歡迎我們。

example_en: The dog became hostile when the stranger approached.
example_zh: 當陌生人靠近時，那隻狗變得很兇惡。

example_en: There was a lot of hostility between the two groups.
example_zh: 這兩個群體之間存在許多敵意。

example_en: I bought a hot dog at the baseball game.
example_zh: 我在棒球比賽時買了一個熱狗。

example_en: The reporters continued to hound the celebrity.
example_zh: 記者們繼續追逐那位名人。

example_en: The large estate employs a full-time housekeeper.
example_zh: 這處大宅邸雇用了一名全職管家。

example_en: She is a housewife with three children.
example_zh: 她是一位有三個孩子的家庭主婦。

example_en: He helps with the housework on weekends.
example_zh: 他週末會幫忙做家務。

example_en: A helicopter hovered above the building.
example_zh: 一架直升機在大樓上方盤旋。

example_en: The wind howled through the trees.
example_zh: 風在樹林間呼嘯而過。

example_en: We are planning a trip to Hualian next month.
example_zh: 我們下個月計劃去花蓮旅行。

example_en: She gave her mother a big hug.
example_zh: 她給了她母親一個大大的擁抱。

example_en: She began to hum a tune while she worked.
example_zh: 她工作時開始哼起歌來。

example_en: He is a humble man despite his success.
example_zh: 儘管他很成功，但他是一個謙遜的人。
special_usage: can also be a verb meaning to lower someone's pride (也可作動詞，意為使謙卑)

example_en: It was a hot and humid summer day.
example_zh: 那是一個炎熱潮濕的夏日。

example_en: He didn't want to humiliate his opponent in public.
example_zh: 他不想在公眾面前羞辱他的對手。

example_en: He felt a deep sense of humiliation after failing the test.
example_zh: 考試失敗後，他感到深深的羞辱感。

example_en: She has a humorous way of looking at life.
example_zh: 她有一種幽默的生活態度。

example_en: I have a hunch that it's going to rain today.
example_zh: 我有預感今天會下雨。
special_usage: 也可以當動詞，指（因不適而）弓起背

example_en: Overcoming this financial hurdle is our first priority.
example_zh: 克服這個財務障礙是我們的首要任務。
special_usage: 也可指跨欄比賽中的欄架

example_en: The player hurled the ball towards the goal.
example_zh: 球員將球猛力投向球門。

example_en: In her hurry, she left her keys at home.
example_zh: 匆忙之中，她把鑰匙忘在了家裡。
special_usage: Can also be a verb (也可作動詞)

example_en: She put a finger to her lips to hush the children.
example_zh: 她把手指放在嘴唇上讓孩子們安靜下來。

example_en: The villagers built a hut near the river.
example_zh: 村民們在河邊蓋了一間小屋。

example_en: The congregation stood up to sing the hymn.
example_zh: 會眾站起來唱聖歌。

example_en: His constant lies showed his hypocrisy.
example_zh: 他不斷的謊言顯示了他的虛偽。

example_en: A person who says one thing but does another is a hypocrite.
example_zh: 言行不一的人是偽君子。

definition_zh: 歇斯底里的；極度滑稽的
example_en: The movie was so funny that I was hysterical.
example_zh: 這部電影太搞笑了，讓我笑得前仰後合。

example_en: Would you like chocolate or vanilla ice cream?
example_zh: 你想要巧克力還是香草冰淇淋？

example_en: The ship hit an iceberg and sank.
example_zh: 那艘船撞上冰山沉没了。
special_usage: 習語 'tip of the iceberg' (冰山一角)

example_en: Be careful, the roads are icy today.
example_zh: 小心，今天的路面結冰了。

example_en: They had an ideological disagreement.
example_zh: 他們在意識形態上存在分歧。

example_en: His political ideology is based on freedom.
example_zh: 他的政治思想體系是基於自由。

example_en: 'Break a leg' is an idiom for good luck.
example_zh: 'Break a leg' 是祝好運的慣用語。

example_en: Don't be such an idiot!
example_zh: 別像個傻瓜一樣！

example_en: He used a match to ignite the candle.
example_zh: 他用火柴點燃了蠟燭。

example_en: Ignorance of the law is no excuse.
example_zh: 對法律的無知不能成為藉口。

example_en: He was ignorant of the basic facts.
example_zh: 他對基本事實一無所知。

example_en: The study illuminates the causes of the disease.
example_zh: 這項研究闡明了該疾病的原因。

example_en: The mirrors created an illusion of space.
example_zh: 鏡子營造出一種空間的錯覺。

example_en: Let me illustrate my point with an example.
example_zh: 讓我用一個例子來說明我的觀點。

example_en: We tried every imaginable method.
example_zh: 我們嘗試了所有能想像到的方法。
special_usage: 常與最高級形容詞連用 (如 every, the only)

example_en: The monster in my dream was purely imaginary.
example_zh: 我夢裡的怪物純粹是虛構的。

example_en: She is an imaginative writer.
example_zh: 她是一位富有想像力的作家。

example_en: Parrots can imitate human speech.
example_zh: 鸚鵡能模仿人類說話。

example_en: His mannerisms are just a poor imitation of his father.
example_zh: 他的舉止只是拙劣地模仿他父親。

example_en: The project requires an immense amount of time.
example_zh: 這個項目需要花費大量的時間。

example_en: She immersed herself in her work.
example_zh: 她專注於自己的工作。
special_usage: 常與反身代名詞連用 (immerse oneself in)

example_en: The city has many immigrants from Asia.
example_zh: 這個城市有許多來自亞洲的移民。
special_usage: 指從外地移入本國者 (反義詞：emigrant)

example_en: People often immigrate to find better jobs.
example_zh: 人們常為了尋找更好的工作而移居。

definition_zh: 即將發生的，迫在眉睫的
example_en: The storm is imminent.
example_zh: 暴風雨即將來臨。

example_en: Lack of sleep can impair your concentration.
example_zh: 睡眠不足會損害你的專注力。

definition_zh: 給予（尤指抽象事物）；傳授
example_en: He imparted his wisdom to the younger generation.
example_zh: 他將智慧傳授給了年輕一代。

definition_zh: 必要的，極重要的；命令式的
example_en: It is imperative that we act now.
example_zh: 我們現在必須採取行動。
special_usage: 用於虛擬語氣 (It is imperative that...)

definition_zh: 冷淡的，無人情味的；客觀的
example_en: The letter was written in a very impersonal style.
example_zh: 這封信寫得非常客觀（缺乏個人情感）。

example_en: The new evidence gave fresh impetus to the investigation.
example_zh: 新證據為調查提供了新的動力。

example_en: She resigned, with the implication that she had been forced to do so.
example_zh: 她辭職了，暗示她是被迫的。

example_en: He had implicit trust in his secretary.
example_zh: 他對秘書有絕對的信任。

example_en: Are you implying that I am responsible for this?
example_zh: 你是在暗示我要對此負責嗎？

definition_zh: 壯觀的；令人印象深刻的
example_en: The castle is an imposing building on the hill.
example_zh: 那座城堡是山上一座氣勢恢宏的建築。

definition_zh: 給……留下深刻印象；使銘記
example_en: I was impressed by his dedication.
example_zh: 他的敬業精神給我留下了深刻印象。

example_en: He was imprisoned for theft.
example_zh: 他因盜竊罪被監禁。

example_en: He was sentenced to life imprisonment.
example_zh: 他被判處終身監禁。

example_en: She bought the dress on impulse.
example_zh: 她一時衝動買下了這件衣服。

example_en: He is impulsive and often regrets his decisions.
example_zh: 他很衝動，常常後悔自己的決定。

example_en: His inability to swim saved his life.
example_zh: 他不會游泳反而救了他一命。

example_en: The new stadium will be inaugurated next week.
example_zh: 新體育場將於下周舉行落成典禮。

example_en: The smell of incense filled the temple.
example_zh: 寺廟裡充滿了熏香的味道。
special_usage: 也可作動詞，意為「激怒」（to make sb very angry），此處提供名詞用法。

example_en: Transport costs are incidental to the project.
example_zh: 運輸成本是該計劃的附帶費用。

example_en: Incidentally, have you seen my keys?
example_zh: 順便問一下，你看到我的鑰匙了嗎？

example_en: I am inclined to agree with you.
example_zh: 我傾向於同意你的觀點。

example_en: It is incumbent upon us to help those in need.
example_zh: 幫助有需要的人是我們的責任。
special_usage: 也可作名詞，指「現任者」或「在職者」。

example_en: He incurred huge debts while gambling.
example_zh: 他在賭博時欠下了巨額債務。

example_en: He has been given an indefinite suspension from the team.
example_zh: 他被球隊無限期停賽。

example_en: Her success is indicative of her hard work.
example_zh: 她的成功表明了她的努力工作。
special_usage: 常與 of 連用 (be indicative of)

example_en: The grand jury issued an indictment against the suspect.
example_zh: 大陪審團對嫌疑人發出了起訴書。

example_en: He treated my pleas with cold indifference.
example_zh: 他以冷漠的態度對待我的懇求。

example_en: She was indifferent to the political debate.
example_zh: 她對這場政治辯論漠不關心。

example_en: The employee was indignant at the false accusations.
example_zh: 這名員工對不實的指控感到憤慨。

example_en: There was public indignation over the new tax.
example_zh: 公眾對這項新稅收感到憤慨。

definition_zh: 不可或缺的，絕對必要的
example_en: Water is indispensable for life.
example_zh: 水是生命不可或缺的。
special_usage: 常與介系詞 to 或 for 連用。

example_en: We decided to stay indoors because of the rain.
example_zh: 因為下雨，我們決定待在室內。

example_en: The medicine induced a deep sleep.
example_zh: 藥物導致了深沉的睡眠。

example_en: I sometimes indulge in a piece of chocolate cake.
example_zh: 我有時會放縱自己吃一塊巧克力蛋糕。
special_usage: 常與 in 連用，指沉溺於某事。

example_en: The country rapidly industrialized during the 19th century.
example_zh: 該國在 19 世紀迅速工業化。

example_en: She couldn't overcome her inertia and stayed in bed.
example_zh: 她無法克服自身的惰性，只能躺在床上。

definition_zh: 不可避免的，必然發生的
example_en: Change is inevitable in life.
example_zh: 改變是人生中不可避免的。

example_en: The infantry was sent to the front lines.
example_zh: 步兵部隊被派往前線。
special_usage: 通常當作複數名詞使用（集合名詞）。

example_en: One sick student infected the whole class.
example_zh: 一名生病的學生傳染了全班。

example_en: From your silence, I infer that you agree.
example_zh: 從你的沉默中，我推斷你同意了。

example_en: He drew a wrong inference from the data.
example_zh: 他從數據中得出了錯誤的推論。

example_en: This product is inferior to the premium version.
example_zh: 這個產品比高級版差。
special_usage: 常與介系詞 to 連用。

example_en: The storm inflicted severe damage on the village.
example_zh: 暴風雨給村莊造成了嚴重的損害。
special_usage: 常用搭配：inflict something on someone。

example_en: She is an influential figure in the art world.
example_zh: 她在藝術界是位有影響力的人物。

definition_zh: 靈巧的；精巧的；設計獨特的
example_en: It was an ingenious solution to a difficult problem.
example_zh: 這是解決難題的一個巧妙方案。

example_en: He used his ingenuity to fix the broken engine.
example_zh: 他發揮創造力修好了壞掉的引擎。

example_en: Flour is a key ingredient in bread.
example_zh: 麵粉是麵包的關鍵原料。

example_en: Tribesmen used to inhabit this island.
example_zh: 以前有部落居民居住在這個島上。

example_en: The lake provides a home for many aquatic inhabitants.
example_zh: 這個湖為許多水生生物提供了家園。

definition_zh: 內在的，固有的，與生俱來的
example_en: There are inherent risks in investing in the stock market.
example_zh: 投資股市存在內在的風險。

example_en: She will inherit the family estate when she turns eighteen.
example_zh: 她滿十八歲時將繼承這筆家族地產。

example_en: High temperatures can inhibit the growth of plants.
example_zh: 高溫會抑制植物的生長。

example_en: He felt too inhibited to dance at the party.
example_zh: 他在派對上感到太拘謹而不敢跳舞。

example_en: She drank alcohol to overcome her social inhibitions.
example_zh: 她喝了酒來克服社交上的拘謹。

example_en: The government plans to initiate a new education reform.
example_zh: 政府計劃發起一項新的教育改革。

example_en: The nurse will inject the medicine into your arm.
example_zh: 護士會把藥物注射到你的手臂裡。

example_en: He was badly injured in the car crash.
example_zh: 他在車禍中嚴重受傷。

example_en: It is a grave injustice to treat people differently based on their skin color.
example_zh: 因膚色不同而差異對待人們是極大的不公。

example_en: We took a train to an inland city.
example_zh: 我們乘火車去了一個內陸城市。

example_en: The small boat was anchored in the calm inlet.
example_zh: 這艘小船停泊在平靜的小灣裡。

definition_zh: 同住者；（監獄）囚犯；（精神病院）病人
example_en: The prison inmate wrote a letter to the governor.
example_zh: 那名監獄囚犯寫了一封信給州長。

example_en: The home team scored three runs in the fifth inning.
example_zh: 主隊在第五局拿下三分。
special_usage: 常用複數 'innings' 表示『一段時期』（如政權時期）。

example_en: The evidence proved his innocence.
example_zh: 證據證明了他的清白。

example_en: There are innumerable stars in the universe.
example_zh: 宇宙中有無數的星星。

example_en: The plan to swim across the ocean alone sounds insane.
example_zh: 獨自游過海洋的計畫聽起來很瘋狂。

example_en: Mosquitoes are small flying insects.
example_zh: 蚊子是會飛的小昆蟲。

example_en: Farmers use insecticide to protect their crops.
example_zh: 農夫使用殺蟲劑來保護他們的作物。

definition_zh: 不安全的；缺乏自信的；不穩固的
example_en: He felt insecure about his public speaking skills.
example_zh: 他對自己的演講技巧缺乏自信。

example_en: He insisted on checking every detail personally.
example_zh: 他堅持親自檢查每個細節。

example_en: Her insistence on punctuality impressed the manager.
example_zh: 她對守時的堅持讓經理印象深刻。

example_en: The waiter was insistent that we try the special.
example_zh: 服務員堅決要我們試試今日特餐。

example_en: Health officials will inspect the restaurant tomorrow.
example_zh: 衛生官員明天將視察這家餐廳。

example_en: Her courage inspired everyone in the room.
example_zh: 她的勇氣鼓舞了房間裡的每個人。
special_usage: inspire sb. to do sth. 激勵某人做某事

example_en: Political instability affected the country's economy.
example_zh: 政治不穩定影響了該國的經濟。

definition_zh: 分期付款；（故事的）一集/一部分
example_en: He pays $200 monthly in installments for his car.
example_zh: 他每月分期付款200美元買車。

example_en: The microwave provides instantaneous heat.
example_zh: 微波爐提供瞬間加熱。

example_en: Birds have an instinct to migrate south in winter.
example_zh: 鳥類有在冬天南遷的本能。

example_en: Her instinctive reaction was to protect the child.
example_zh: 她本能的反應是保護孩子。

example_en: The teacher instructed the students to remain silent.
example_zh: 老師指示學生保持安靜。
special_usage: instruct sb. to do sth. 指示某人做某事

example_en: Thick curtains help insulate the room from cold.
example_zh: 厚窗簾有助於將房間與寒冷隔絕。

example_en: His rude comments were meant to insult her.
example_zh: 他粗魯的評論意在侮辱她。
special_usage: add insult to injury 雪上加霜

example_en: We need to insure our house against fire.
example_zh: 我們需要為房子投保火險。

example_en: The insurer agreed to cover the repair costs.
example_zh: 保險公司同意支付修理費用。

example_en: The fragile vase arrived intact.
example_zh: 易碎的花瓶完好無損地送達了。

example_en: He was a man of great intellect.
example_zh: 他是個才智非凡的人。

example_en: His explanation was barely intelligible.
example_zh: 他的解釋幾乎聽不懂。
special_usage: intelligible to 對...來說易懂的

example_en: The storm will intensify as it approaches land.
example_zh: 暴風雨登陸時將會增強。

example_en: Social intercourse is important in business.
example_zh: 社交往來在商業中很重要。

example_en: Please don't interfere with my work.
example_zh: 請不要干擾我的工作。
special_usage: interfere in 幉涉... / interfere with 妨礙...

example_en: The patient suffered from intermittent fever.
example_zh: 這位病人發了間歇燒。

example_en: Can you interpret this ancient poem for me?
example_zh: 你能幫我解釋這首古詩嗎？

example_en: The UN provided an interpreter for the meeting.
example_zh: 聯合國為會議提供了一名口譯員。

example_en: Please don't interrupt me while I'm speaking.
example_zh: 我說話時請不要打斷我。

example_en: I'm sorry for the interruption.
example_zh: 很抱歉造成干擾。

example_en: The government had to intervene in the strike.
example_zh: 政府不得不介入這場罷工。

example_en: They developed a sense of intimacy after working together.
example_zh: 一起工作後，他們建立了親密感。

example_en: The bully tried to intimidate the younger students.
example_zh: 那個惡霸試圖恐嚇年幼的學生。

example_en: His French intonation is very accurate.
example_zh: 他的法語語調非常準確。

definition_zh: 複雜精緻的，錯綜複雜的
example_en: The necklace has an intricate design.
example_zh: 這條項鍊有著錯綜複雜的設計。

example_en: The mystery novel intrigued the reader.
example_zh: 這本推理小說引起了讀者的興趣。

example_en: Diamonds have intrinsic value.
example_zh: 鑽石具有內在價值。

example_en: I hope I'm not intruding on your privacy.
example_zh: 我希望沒有侵犯你的隱私。

example_en: The alarm scared off the intruder.
example_zh: 警報聲嚇跑了闖入者。

example_en: He considered the question an intrusion.
example_zh: 他認為這個問題是一種干擾。

example_en: She acted on her intuition.
example_zh: 她憑直覺行事。

example_en: The army prepared to invade the country.
example_zh: 軍隊準備侵略該國。

example_en: Your help has been invaluable.
example_zh: 你的幫助是無價的。
special_usage: 注意：雖然字尾有-val，但並非指『沒有價值』，而是指『價值高到無法估量』。

example_en: Coffee is his invariable breakfast choice.
example_zh: 咖啡是他早餐不變的選擇。

example_en: Did you invent this story?
example_zh: 這故事是你編造的嗎？

example_en: Thomas Edison was a famous inventor.
example_zh: 托馬斯·愛迪生是一位著名的發明家。

example_en: Please invert the image before printing.
example_zh: 請在列印前將圖片倒置。

example_en: The smell of fresh coffee was inviting.
example_zh: 新鮮咖啡的香味很誘人。

example_en: She had a deep inward conflict.
example_zh: 她內心深處有著劇烈的衝突。

example_en: His high IQ helped him solve the puzzle quickly.
example_zh: 他的高智商幫助他迅速解開了難題。

example_en: It is ironic that the fire station burned down.
example_zh: 消防局竟然被燒毀了，這真的很諷刺。

example_en: The irony of the situation was not lost on us.
example_zh: 我們都聽出了這個處境的諷刺意味。

example_en: The chocolate cake looked irresistible.
example_zh: 那巧克力蛋糕看起來令人無法抗拒。

example_en: We send gifts to all children irrespective of age.
example_zh: 我們送禮物給所有的小孩，不分年齡。

example_en: He is very irritable when he is hungry.
example_zh: 他肚子餓的時候脾氣非常暴躁。

example_en: The constant noise irritated him.
example_zh: 持續的噪音激怒了他。

example_en: She tried to hide her irritation.
example_zh: 她試圖掩飾她的惱怒。

example_en: Patients with the virus must be isolated.
example_zh: 感染病毒的患者必須被隔離。

example_en: I have an itch on my back.
example_zh: 我背上有個地方很癢。
special_usage: 也可指 '渴望' (itch to do something)

example_en: The old building was covered in ivy.
example_zh: 那棟老建築爬滿了常春藤。

example_en: The janitor cleans the hallways after school.
example_zh: 管理員在放學後清潔走廊。

example_en: She wore a jasmine flower in her hair.
example_zh: 她在頭髮上別了一朵茉莉花。

example_en: He broke his jaw in the accident.
example_zh: 他在意外中弄斷了下巴。

example_en: Don't jaywalk; it's dangerous.
example_zh: 不要亂穿馬路，那很危險。

example_en: She was jealous of her sister's success.
example_zh: 她嫉妒她姐姐的成功。

example_en: His success caused jealousy among his peers.
example_zh: 他的成功引起了同儕的嫉妒。

example_en: The crowd started to jeer at the referee.
example_zh: 群眾開始嘲弄裁判。

example_en: I spread some strawberry jelly on my toast.
example_zh: 我在吐司上塗了些草莓果醬。

example_en: Smoking will jeopardize your health.
example_zh: 吸菸會危及你的健康。

example_en: He pulled the rope with a sharp jerk.
example_zh: 他猛拉了一下繩子。

definition_zh: 叮噹聲；朗朗上口的短歌
example_en: The bell gave a little jingle.
example_zh: 鈴鐺發出了清脆的叮噹聲。

example_en: He has been jobless for six months.
example_zh: 他已經失業六個月了。

example_en: The jockey rode the horse to victory.
example_zh: 這位騎師策騎賽馬贏得了勝利。
special_usage: 亦可作動詞，意為運用手段獲取（常與 for 連用）。

example_en: I go for a jog in the park every morning.
example_zh: 我每天早上都會去公園慢跑。

example_en: The wedding was a joyful occasion.
example_zh: 婚禮是個歡樂的場合。

definition_zh: 充滿歡樂的（通常指性質或氣氛）
example_en: The children's laughter filled the room with joyous sounds.
example_zh: 孩子們的笑聲讓房間充滿了歡樂的聲音。

example_en: The judiciary is an independent branch of the government.
example_zh: 司法部門是政府獨立的一支。

example_en: Please pour the milk from the jug into the glass.
example_zh: 請把牛奶從水壺倒進玻璃杯裡。

example_en: This orange is very juicy.
example_zh: 這顆柳丁非常多汁。
special_usage: 引申義指（八卦或故事）精彩、有趣。

example_en: She wore a warm wool jumper.
example_zh: 她穿了一件保暖的羊毛衫。
special_usage: 英式英語指毛衣；美式英語指連身裙（sweater）。

definition_zh: 初中（通常指七年級至九年級）
example_en: My brother is in junior high school.
example_zh: 我的弟弟正在讀初中。

definition_zh: 辯解的理由；正當化的理由
example_en: There is no justification for his rude behavior.
example_zh: 他無禮的行為沒有任何正當理由。

definition_zh: 有正當理由的；合乎情理的
example_en: His anger was justified given the circumstances.
example_zh: 考慮到當時的情況，他生氣是合情合理的。

example_en: A kangaroo can jump very high.
example_zh: 袋鼠可以跳得很高。

example_en: Kaohsiung is a major port city in Taiwan.
example_zh: 高雄是台灣主要的港口城市。

example_en: The soccer keeper saved the goal.
example_zh: 這位足球守門員擋下了那一球。

example_en: Can you pass me the ketchup?
example_zh: 你能把番茄醬遞給我嗎？

example_en: The kettle is boiling.
example_zh: 水壺裡的水開了。

example_en: The billionaire was kidnapped on his way home.
example_zh: 那位億萬富翁在回家的路上被綁架了。

example_en: Please weigh the apples; I want exactly two kilograms.
example_zh: 請幫忙秤一下蘋果；我要剛好兩公斤。

example_en: The nearest gas station is five kilometers away.
example_zh: 最近的加油站離這裡有五公里遠。

example_en: He has no living kin in this country.
example_zh: 他在這個國家沒有在世的親屬了。
special_usage: 通常用作集合名詞 (pl. kin)

example_en: My daughter started kindergarten this year.
example_zh: 我女兒今年開始上幼稚園了。

example_en: The campfire was kindled with dry twigs.
example_zh: 營火是用乾樹枝點燃的。

example_en: Would you kindly close the window?
example_zh: 麻煩你把窗戶關上好吗？
special_usage: 作形容詞時常置於名詞前 (a kindly smile)

example_en: She showed great kindness to the stray dog.
example_zh: 她對那隻流浪狗展現了極大的善意。

example_en: We flew a kite in the park on sunny day.
example_zh: 晴朗的日子裡我們在公園放風箏。

example_en: The mother cat gave birth to four kittens.
example_zh: 那隻母貓生了四隻小貓。

example_en: He knelt down to tie his shoelaces.
example_zh: 他蹲下身子繫鞋帶。
special_usage: 變化：kneel, knelt, knelt (或 knelt, knelt)

example_en: Turn the knob to the right to open the door.
example_zh: 把球形把手向右轉就能打開門。

example_en: My stomach was in knots before the interview.
example_zh: 面試前我緊張得胃都打結了。

example_en: He has the technical know-how to fix the computer.
example_zh: 他有修這台電腦的技術能力。
special_usage: 通常作不可數名詞使用

example_en: She is very knowledgeable about ancient history.
example_zh: 她對古代歷史非常博學。

example_en: He knocked on the door with his knuckle.
example_zh: 他用指關節敲了敲門。

example_en: Koalas sleep for up to 20 hours a day.
example_zh: 無尾熊一天可以睡長達20個小時。

example_en: We are going to KTV to celebrate tonight.
example_zh: 我們今晚要去KTV慶祝。
special_usage: 源自日語或中文（Karaaoke Television），通常全大寫或小寫

example_en: He's a nice lad with a great sense of humor.
example_zh: 他是個很有幽默感的帥小伙。

example_en: A ladybug landed on the leaf.
example_zh: 一隻瓢蟲停在葉子上。
special_usage: 也拼作 ladybird（主要用於英式英語）

example_en: There is a noticeable lag in the video stream.
example_zh: 影片串流有明顯的延遲。
special_usage: 常指網路上的延遲 (network lag)

definition_zh: 跛的；站不住腳的；差勁的
example_en: He gave a lame excuse for being late.
example_zh: 他為遲到找了個蹩腳的藉口。

example_en: They lamented the loss of their friend.
example_zh: 他們為失去朋友而感到悲傷。

example_en: The landlady kindly fixed the leaky faucet.
example_zh: 女房東好心地修好了漏水的水龍頭。

example_en: The landlord increased the rent this year.
example_zh: 房東今年漲了房租。
special_usage: 對應女性為 Landlady (女房東)

example_en: The Taipei 101 is a famous landmark in Taiwan.
example_zh: 台北101是台灣著名的地標。

definition_zh: 山崩；塌方；(選舉)壓倒性勝利
example_en: Heavy rain caused a serious landslide.
example_zh: 大雨造成了嚴重的山崩。

example_en: People light lanterns during the festival.
example_zh: 人們在節慶期間點亮燈籠。

example_en: We eat tangyuan on Lantern Festival.
example_zh: 我們在元宵節吃湯圓。

example_en: The company is planning a large-scale renovation.
example_zh: 公司正在計劃一項大規模的裝修。

example_en: The wind lashed against the windows.
example_zh: 狂風猛烈地拍打著窗戶。

example_en: He has latent artistic talent.
example_zh: 他有潛在的藝術天賦。

example_en: The room was filled with laughter.
example_zh: 房間裡充滿了笑聲。

example_en: Lava flows down the side of the volcano.
example_zh: 熔岩順著火山側流下。

example_en: Could you please tell me where the lavatory is?
example_zh: 請問廁所在哪裡？
special_usage: 較正式用語，同義詞有 restroom, bathroom

example_en: They held a lavish wedding ceremony.
example_zh: 他們舉辦了一場盛大的婚禮。

example_en: Citizens have the right to lawful protection.
example_zh: 公民有權獲得合法的保護。

example_en: The lawmakers voted on the new bill.
example_zh: 立法者對新法案進行了投票。

example_en: The instructions are hard for a layman to understand.
example_zh: 這些說明對外行來說很難理解。

example_en: The host gave a brief lead-in to the interview.
example_zh: 主持人簡單開場後進入訪問環節。

example_en: Please read this leaflet for more information.
example_zh: 請閱讀這張傳單以獲取更多資訊。

example_en: There is a gas leak in the kitchen.
example_zh: 廚房有瓦斯洩漏。

example_en: The cat leaped onto the table.
example_zh: 那隻貓跳到了桌子上。

example_en: She is an active learner of new languages.
example_zh: 她是新語言的積極學習者。

example_en: The lecturer gave an interesting speech.
example_zh: 那位講師發表了一場有趣的演講。

example_en: He writes with his left-hand.
example_zh: 他用左手寫字。

example_en: He has left-wing political views.
example_zh: 他持有左翼的政治觀點。

example_en: The legislator voted against the new law.
example_zh: 那位立法者投票反對新法律。

example_en: We took a leisurely walk along the beach.
example_zh: 我們沿著海灘悠閒地散步。
special_usage: 亦可作副詞 (adv) 使用，意為悠閒地

example_en: I would like a glass of lemonade.
example_zh: 我想要一杯檸檬水。

example_en: Can you lend me a pen?
example_zh: 你能借我一支筆嗎？

example_en: We need to lengthen the skirt.
example_zh: 我們需要把裙子加長。

example_en: The meeting was rather lengthy.
example_zh: 那場會議相當冗長。

example_en: The leopard is known for its spots.
example_zh: 豹以其身上的斑點而聞名。

example_en: The medicine helped lessen the pain.
example_zh: 藥物幫助減輕了疼痛。

example_en: She whispered lest she be heard.
example_zh: 她低聲說話以免被人聽見。
special_usage: 後接 that 子句或 (should) + 動詞原形

example_en: The poison is lethal to humans.
example_zh: 這種毒藥對人類是致命的。

example_en: I put some lettuce in my sandwich.
example_zh: 我在三明治裡放了一些生菜。

example_en: He pulled the lever to start the machine.
example_zh: 他拉動槓桿以啟動機器。

example_en: He is a liar; don't trust him.
example_zh: 他是個騙子，別相信他。

example_en: The newspaper was sued for libel.
example_zh: 該報社因誹謗而被起訴。

example_en: The government decided to liberalize the market.
example_zh: 政府決定開放市場自由化。

example_en: The soldiers liberated the prisoners.
example_zh: 士兵們釋放了囚犯。

example_en: The country celebrated the liberation from tyranny.
example_zh: 該國慶祝從暴政中解放。

example_en: The cat began to lick its fur.
example_zh: 貓開始舔它的毛。

example_en: The lieutenant gave the order to advance.
example_zh: 中尉下令前進。

example_en: Passengers were instructed to board the lifeboats immediately.
example_zh: 乘客被指示立即登上救生艇。

example_en: The lifeguard blew his whistle to warn the swimmers.
example_zh: 救生員吹哨子警告游泳者。

example_en: They shared a lifelong friendship.
example_zh: 他們有著終身的友誼。

example_en: She opened the curtains to lighten the room.
example_zh: 她拉開窗簾讓房間變亮。

example_en: The ship navigated safely thanks to the lighthouse.
example_zh: 船隻因為燈塔而安全航行。

example_en: The pond was covered with blooming water lilies.
example_zh: 池塘上開滿了盛開的水百合。

example_en: He stretched his limbs after the workout.
example_zh: 他在健身後伸展四肢。

example_en: They arrived at the gala in a black limousine.
example_zh: 他們坐著黑色豪華轎車抵達晚會。

example_en: The injured player limped off the field.
example_zh: 受傷的球員跛著腳離開球場。

example_en: The hotel provides fresh linen every day.
example_zh: 飯店每天提供乾淨的床單。

example_en: We took a transatlantic liner to Europe.
example_zh: 我們搭乘橫渡大西洋的班輪去歐洲。

example_en: The police showed the victim a lineup of suspects.
example_zh: 警方讓受害者指認一排嫌犯。

example_en: The smell of perfume lingered in the air.
example_zh: 香水味在空氣中久久不散。

example_en: The linguist analyzed the sentence structure.
example_zh: 語言學家分析了句子結構。

example_en: The jacket has a warm fleece lining.
example_zh: 這件夾克有溫暖的羊毛內襯。

example_en: She applied red lipstick before the meeting.
example_zh: 她在開會前塗了紅色口紅。

example_en: He prefers whiskey as his hard liquor of choice.
example_zh: 他比較喜歡威士忌作為他的烈酒選擇。

example_en: She is a very attentive listener.
example_zh: 她是一個非常專心的聽者。

example_en: The bottle holds one liter of water.
example_zh: 這瓶子裝了一公升的水。

example_en: What is the literal meaning of this word?
example_zh: 這個詞的字面意思是什麼？
special_usage: In the literal sense（在字面意義上）。

definition_zh: 有讀寫能力的；有文化的
example_en: The literacy rate in this country is very high.
example_zh: 這個國家的識字率很高。
special_usage: Can also mean well-read or educated.（亦指博學的）。

example_en: Please do not leave litter on the beach.
example_zh: 請勿在沙灘上留下垃圾。
special_usage: 也可作動詞，意為「使雜亂」。

example_en: They hired a live-in nanny to help with the kids.
example_zh: 他們請了一位住家保姆來幫忙照顧孩子。
special_usage: 通常用於描述僱員（如保姆、管家）。

example_en: She has a lively personality.
example_zh: 她的個性很活潑。

example_en: We gathered in the living room to watch TV.
example_zh: 我們聚集在客廳看電視。

example_en: I saw a green lizard on the wall.
example_zh: 我看到一隻綠色的蜥蜴在牆上。

example_en: The children were excited to see a llama at the zoo.
example_zh: 孩子們在動物園看到羊駝很興奮。

example_en: Could you buy a loaf of bread?
example_zh: 你可以買一條麵包嗎？
special_usage: 常用片語：Use your loaf（動動腦筋/別傻了，英式俚語）。

example_en: Lobster is considered a delicacy.
example_zh: 龍蝦被視為美味。

example_en: The locality is known for its beautiful scenery.
example_zh: 這個地區以其美麗的風景聞名。

example_en: Put your bags in the locker.
example_zh: 把你的包放進儲物櫃裡。

example_en: The steam locomotive chugged along the track.
example_zh: 蒸汽機車沿著軌道咔嚓咔嚓地前進。
special_usage: 也可作形容詞，意為「運動的」。

example_en: A swarm of locusts destroyed the crops.
example_zh: 一大群蝗蟲摧毀了農作物。

example_en: He has lofty ideals.
example_zh: 他有崇高的理想。
special_usage: 常帶有「不切實際」或「傲慢」的負面暗示。

example_en: The child was sucking on a lollipop.
example_zh: 那個小孩正在舔棒棒糖。
special_usage: 亦可指交通指揮棒（lollipop man/woman）。

example_en: She felt a deep sense of loneliness.
example_zh: 她感到深深的孤獨感。

example_en: The cowboy felt lonesome on the trail.
example_zh: 那位牛仔在小徑上感到很寂寞。

example_en: A healthy diet contributes to longevity.
example_zh: 健康的飲食有助於長壽。

example_en: They have a long-standing relationship.
example_zh: 他們有長久的關係。
special_usage: 通常用於形容關係、問題或傳統。

example_en: We need a long-term solution to this problem.
example_zh: 我們需要一個長期的解決方案來應對這個問題。
special_usage: often hyphenated when used as a modifier

example_en: He is a longtime supporter of the local team.
example_zh: 他是該本地隊伍的長期支持者。

example_en: A crisis is looming on the horizon.
example_zh: 危機正在地平線上隱現。
special_usage: 常與 large, over 等介係詞連用

example_en: Please loosen the screw.
example_zh: 請把螺絲釘鬆開。

example_en: The invaders looted the city of its treasures.
example_zh: 入侵者掠奪了該城市的寶藏。

example_en: The delivery was made by a large lorry.
example_zh: 貨物是由一輛大卡車運送的。
special_usage: 主要用于英式英語 (美式英語用 truck)

example_en: He is a sore loser who hates to lose.
example_zh: 他是個輸不起的人，很討厭失敗。

example_en: She applied sunscreen lotion to her skin.
example_zh: 她把防曬乳液塗抹在皮膚上。

example_en: The announcer spoke through a loudspeaker.
example_zh: 播音員透過擴音器講話。

example_en: I had a lousy day at work today.
example_zh: 我今天工作過得非常糟糕。
special_usage: 非正式用語，帶有抱怨或輕蔑的語氣

example_en: Dogs are loyal animals.
example_zh: 狗是忠誠的動物。

example_en: Her loyalty to the company was unquestionable.
example_zh: 她對公司的忠誠是毋庸置疑的。

example_en: You should lubricate the gears regularly.
example_zh: 你應該定期給齒輪上潤滑油。

example_en: He turned down a lucrative job offer.
example_zh: 他拒絕了一份賺錢的工作邀約。

example_en: The mother sang a lullaby to her baby.
example_zh: 母親對著寶寶唱搖籃曲。

example_en: They cut down trees to make lumber.
example_zh: 他們砍伐樹木來製作木材。
special_usage: 作動詞時常表示行動笨拙或緩慢

example_en: The watch has a luminous dial.
example_zh: 這隻手錶的表面會發光。

example_en: There is a lump of sugar in my coffee.
example_zh: 我的咖啡裡有一塊糖。
special_usage: 常見片語 lump sum (一筆過款項)

example_en: The lunar calendar is still used in some cultures.
example_zh: 有些文化仍使用陰曆。

example_en: That was a lunatic idea!
example_zh: 那真是個瘋狂的主意！
special_usage: 通常用於形容行為極度愚蠢或不顧後果

example_en: Let's meet at the cafeteria during lunchtime.
example_zh: 我們午餐時間在自助餐廳見吧。

example_en: The detective used a fake identity to lure the suspect out of hiding.
example_zh: 偵探利用虛假身分，將嫌犯引誘出藏身之處。

definition_zh: 草木茂盛的；豪華舒適的
example_en: The hotel is surrounded by lush tropical gardens.
example_zh: 這家飯店被草木茂盛的熱帶花園所環繞。

example_en: They stayed in a luxurious suite with a view of the ocean.
example_zh: 他們住在一間能眺望海洋的奢華套房裡。

example_en: I love the sweet and fragrant taste of fresh lychee.
example_zh: 我喜歡新鮮荔枝甜美芬芳的味道。

example_en: The angry mob decided to lynch the accused criminal.
example_zh: 憤怒的暴民決定私刑處死那名被指控的罪犯。
special_usage: 通常指一群人對涉嫌犯罪者施以暴力處決。

definition_zh: 夫人；女士（對女性的尊稱）
example_en: Excuse me, ma'am, you dropped your wallet.
example_zh: 這位女士，不好意思，您的錢包掉了。
special_usage: Madam 的縮寫，用於對女性長輩或上司的禮貌稱呼。

example_en: This way, madam. I will show you to your table.
example_zh: 女士，這邊請。我帶您到您的座位。
special_usage: 比 Ma'am 正式，也可用於稱呼妓院的老闆娘。

example_en: The story he told was completely made-up.
example_zh: 他講的故事完全是虛構的。
special_usage: 動詞短語 Make up 的過去分詞當形容詞用。

example_en: The film depicts the violent power struggles within the Italian mafia.
example_zh: 這部電影描寫了義大利黑手黨內部的暴力權力鬥爭。
special_usage: 首字母大寫 (Mafia) 特指西西里黑手黨。

example_en: The children gasped as the magician pulled a rabbit out of the hat.
example_zh: 當魔術師從帽子裡拉出一隻兔子時，孩子們驚呼連連。

example_en: The case was heard by a magistrate in the local court.
example_zh: 這起案件由地方法院的治安法官審理。
special_usage: 通常指職位較低的司法官，處理輕微罪行。

example_en: This lens can magnify the image up to 200 times.
example_zh: 這個透鏡可以將影像放大到 200 倍。

example_en: The hotel maid cleaned the room while we were at breakfast.
example_zh: 當我們在吃早餐時，飯店的女傭打掃了房間。
special_usage: 也可指未婚女子 (Maidservant 的縮寫)。

example_en: The mail carrier delivered a package to our door today.
example_zh: 郵差今天送了一個包裹到我們家門口。

example_en: The majestic mountains stood tall against the blue sky.
example_zh: 雄偉的山脈在藍天的映襯下巍然屹立。

example_en: The king sat on his throne with great majesty.
example_zh: 國王威嚴地坐在王座上。
special_usage: 用於稱呼君主 (如 Your Majesty)。

example_en: Mosquitoes can transmit malaria to humans.
example_zh: 蚊子會將瘧疾傳染給人類。

example_en: A whale is actually a warm-blooded mammal, not a fish.
example_zh: 鯨魚其實是溫血的哺乳動物，而不是魚類。

example_en: Breaking the project into smaller tasks made it much more manageable.
example_zh: 將專案拆分為較小的任務，使其變得更易於管理。

example_en: She has been studying Mandarin for three years.
example_zh: 她學習普通話已經三年了。
special_usage: 首字母大寫 (Mandarin) 通常指中文普通話。

example_en: The pilot performed a complex maneuver to avoid the obstacle.
example_zh: 駕駛員執行了一個複雜的動作以避開障礙物。

example_en: I bought a ripe mango from the market.
example_zh: 我從市場買了一顆熟芒果。

example_en: Her anxiety manifested itself through constant pacing.
example_zh: 她透過不停地踱步顯露出她的焦慮。

example_en: The political party released its new manifesto.
example_zh: 該政黨發布了新的宣言。

example_en: He used his charm to manipulate people into doing what he wanted.
example_zh: 他利用他的魅力操縱人們去做他想做的事。

example_en: The space mission was a great achievement for mankind.
example_zh: 這項太空任務是人類的一大成就。

example_en: The lake is actually a man-made reservoir.
example_zh: 這座湖其實是一座人造水庫。

example_en: They inherited a large mansion in the countryside.
example_zh: 他們繼承了鄉下一棟巨大的宅邸。

example_en: The ancient manuscript was written in Latin.
example_zh: 這份古老的手稿是用拉丁文寫的。

example_en: The farmer has several mares in the pasture.
example_zh: 農夫在牧場裡養了幾頭母馬。

example_en: There has been a marginal improvement in sales.
example_zh: 銷售額有微小的增長。

example_en: They plan to marry next spring.
example_zh: 他們計劃明年春天結婚。

example_en: We walked through the marsh to see the birds.
example_zh: 我們走過沼澤去看鳥。

example_en: The marshal organized the parade participants.
example_zh: 元帥整頓了遊行的參與者。

example_en: We had a marvelous time on vacation.
example_zh: 我們度過了一段美妙的假期時光。

example_en: He has a very masculine voice.
example_zh: 他的嗓音非常陽剛。

example_en: Can you mash the potatoes for me?
example_zh: 你能幫我搗碎馬鈴薯嗎？

example_en: The soldiers massacred the innocent villagers.
example_zh: 士兵們屠殺了無辜的村民。

example_en: The Mona Lisa is considered a masterpiece.
example_zh: 《蒙娜麗莎的微笑》被視為一幅傑作。

example_en: She has complete mastery of the French language.
example_zh: 她精通法語。

example_en: Modern society is often criticized for its materialism.
example_zh: 現代社會常因物質主義而受到批評。

example_en: He showed great maturity in handling the situation.
example_zh: 他在處理這情況時表現得非常成熟。

example_en: The sandwich tasted great with a generous spread of mayonnaise.
example_zh: 三明治加了大量的蛋黃醬，吃起來很棒。

example_en: The cows were grazing peacefully in the sunlit meadow.
example_zh: 牛群在陽光普照的草地上平靜地吃草。

example_en: I'll finish this report; in the meantime, please answer the phone.
example_zh: 我會完成這份報告；與此同時，請接一下電話。

example_en: The project has already had a measurable impact on sales.
example_zh: 這個專案對銷售額已經產生了可衡量的影響。

example_en: The mechanic inspected the engine to find the source of the noise.
example_zh: 機械師檢查了引擎以找出噪音的來源。

example_en: A lawyer was called in to mediate the dispute between the two neighbors.
example_zh: 律師被請來調解這兩位鄰居之間的爭端。

example_en: She likes to meditate for twenty minutes every morning to clear her mind.
example_zh: 她喜歡每天早上冥想二十分鐘以清空思緒。

example_en: There was a sense of melancholy in the air as the sun set on the last day of summer.
example_zh: 隨著夏日最後一天的夕陽西下，空氣中瀰漫著一種憂鬱的感覺。

example_en: The jazz music created a mellow atmosphere in the room.
example_zh: 爵士樂在房間裡營造出一種柔和的氛圍。

example_en: The melody of the song is very catchy and easy to remember.
example_zh: 這首歌的旋律非常朗朗上口，容易記住。

example_en: I bought a slice of watermelon to eat on a hot day.
example_zh: 我買了一片西瓜在熱天吃。

example_en: The ice cream began to melt in the warm sun.
example_zh: 冰淇淋在溫暖的陽光下開始融化。

example_en: The trip to Japan was a memorable experience for the whole family.
example_zh: 去日本的旅行對整個家庭來說都是一次難忘的經歷。

example_en: The manager sent a memorandum to all staff regarding the new policy.
example_zh: 經理就新政策向所有員工發送了一份備忘錄。

example_en: Students are required to memorize the historical dates for the exam.
example_zh: 學生需要為了考試記住那些歷史日期。

example_en: Pollution is a growing menace to the environment.
example_zh: 污染是對環境日益增長的威脅。

example_en: She managed to mend the tear in her jeans with a needle and thread.
example_zh: 她設法用針線補好了牛仔褲上的破洞。

example_en: Excuse me, could you tell me where the men's room is?
example_zh: 不好意思，請問男廁所在哪裡？
special_usage: 非正式；也常說 men's restroom

example_en: He has a very competitive mentality and hates to lose.
example_zh: 他的好勝心很強，非常討厭輸。

example_en: The little girl dressed up as a mermaid for Halloween.
example_zh: 小女孩在萬聖節打扮成了美人魚。

example_en: His handwriting is so messy that I can hardly read it.
example_zh: 他的字跡太潦草了，我幾乎認不出來。

example_en: Time is a thief is a common metaphor.
example_zh: 「時間是小偷」是一個常見的隱喻。

example_en: Scientists examined the bacteria under a microscope.
example_zh: 科學家在顯微鏡下檢查細菌。

example_en: We usually have lunch at midday.
example_zh: 我們通常在正午吃午餐。

example_en: He is a middle-aged man with two children.
example_zh: 他是一個有兩個孩子的中年男子。

example_en: She found herself in the midst of a heated argument.
example_zh: 她發現自己身處一場激烈的爭論之中。
special_usage: in the midst of: 在...之中

example_en: The country has strict laws regarding migrant workers.
example_zh: 該國對移民工人有嚴格的法律。

example_en: Many birds migrate to warmer climates during winter.
example_zh: 許多鳥類在冬季遷徙到氣候較溫暖的地方。

example_en: Graduating from college was a major milestone for her.
example_zh: 大學畢業對她來說是一個重要的里程碑。

example_en: The group adopted a militant stance against the government.
example_zh: 該組織採取了對抗政府的激進立場。
special_usage: 亦可作名詞，指激進分子

example_en: The local militia defended the village.
example_zh: 當地的民兵保衛了村莊。

example_en: I ordered a chocolate milkshake.
example_zh: 我點了一杯巧克力奶昔。

example_en: The leaf is only a few millimeters wide.
example_zh: 這片葉子只有幾毫米寬。

example_en: He became a millionaire after selling his company.
example_zh: 他在賣掉公司後成了百萬富翁。

example_en: Parrots can mimic human speech.
example_zh: 鸚鵡可以模仿人類說話。

example_en: The miners worked deep underground.
example_zh: 礦工們在地下深處工作。

example_en: He likes to mingle with guests at parties.
example_zh: 他喜歡在派對上與客人交往。

example_en: They attended a ministerial meeting.
example_zh: 他們參加了一場部長級會議。

example_en: The patient made a miraculous recovery.
example_zh: 病人奇蹟般地康復了。

example_en: She suffered a miscarriage in the first trimester.
example_zh: 她在懷孕的頭三個月流產了。
special_usage: miscarriage of justice: 司法不公

example_en: The children were full of mischief during the holidays.
example_zh: 孩子們在假期裡非常調皮。

example_en: He gave a mischievous grin.
example_zh: 他露出了一個調皮的笑容。

example_en: The old miser hid his money under the floorboards.
example_zh: 那老守財奴把錢藏在地板底下。

example_en: The miserable weather ruined our picnic plans.
example_zh: 糟糕的天氣毀了我們的野餐計畫。

example_en: He brought misery upon himself with his gambling addiction.
example_zh: 他的賭博成癮給自己帶來了痛苦。

example_en: She bore her misfortunes with great dignity.
example_zh: 她以極大的尊嚴忍受了自己的不幸。

example_en: The advertisements were designed to mislead consumers.
example_zh: 這些廣告旨在誤導消費者。
special_usage: 常使用過去分詞 misled (adj.)，意為受騙的或被誤導的。

example_en: The missionary traveled to remote villages to spread his faith.
example_zh: 那位傳教士前往偏遠村莊傳播他的信仰。
special_usage: 亦可作形容詞，意為傳教的。

example_en: A thick mist covered the mountains in the morning.
example_zh: 早晨的濃霧籠罩了群山。

example_en: If I am not mistaken, the train arrives at platform three.
example_zh: 如果我沒弄錯的話，火車會抵達第三月台。
special_usage: 常與介詞 in 連用 (mistaken in one's judgment)。

example_en: Excuse me, mister, you dropped your wallet.
example_zh: 先生，不好意思，你掉了錢包。

example_en: I'm afraid you have misunderstood my intentions.
example_zh: 恐怕你誤會了我的意圖。

example_en: The injured player moaned in pain on the field.
example_zh: 受傷的球員在球場上痛苦地呻吟。

example_en: The police used tear gas to disperse the angry mob.
example_zh: 警方使用催淚瓦斯驅散憤怒的暴民。
special_usage: 常帶有負面色彩，指無組織的混亂人群。

example_en: The government is mobilizing troops to the border.
example_zh: 政府正在向邊境調動部隊。

example_en: He liked to mock his friends in a joking manner.
example_zh: 他喜歡開玩笑地嘲弄他的朋友。
special_usage: 亦可作形容詞，意為模擬的 (mock exam 模擬考試)。

example_en: The modernization of the factory increased productivity.
example_zh: 工廠的現代化提高了生產力。

example_en: We need to modernize our computer systems.
example_zh: 我們需要更新我們的電腦系統。

example_en: Despite his success, he remained a modest man.
example_zh: 儘管很成功，他依然保持謙虛。

example_en: Her modesty prevents her from boasting about her achievements.
example_zh: 她的謙虛使她不會吹噓自己的成就。

example_en: Keep the cake in a container to keep it moist.
example_zh: 把蛋糕放在容器裡以保持濕潤。

example_en: A water molecule consists of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.
example_zh: 一個水分子由兩個氫原子和一個氧原子組成。

example_en: The monarch reigned over the kingdom for fifty years.
example_zh: 這位君主統治該王國達五十年之久。

example_en: The United Kingdom is a constitutional monarchy.
example_zh: 英國是君主立憲制國家。

example_en: The monk meditated in silence for hours.
example_zh: 那位僧侶靜坐冥想數小時。

example_en: The company holds a monopoly on the production of this drug.
example_zh: 該公司擁有這種藥物的生產壟斷權。

example_en: His voice had a monotonous tone that made me sleepy.
example_zh: 他的聲音語調單調，聽得我想睡覺。

example_en: The monotony of his daily routine was beginning to get to him.
example_zh: 他日常生活的單調乏味開始讓他受不了。

definition_zh: 怪獸般的；巨大的；殘忍的
example_en: The plan seemed monstrous and inhuman.
example_zh: 這個計劃聽起來殘忍且不人道。

example_en: They built a monument to honor the fallen soldiers.
example_zh: 他們建立了一座紀念碑來紀念陣亡的士兵。

example_en: She gets moody when she is tired.
example_zh: 她累的時候就會變得喜怒無常。

example_en: We walked home under the bright moonlight.
example_zh: 我們在明亮的月光下走回家。

example_en: The cottage was located on the edge of the moor.
example_zh: 那間小屋位於荒野的邊緣。

example_en: Please use a mop to clean the kitchen floor.
example_zh: 請用拖把清理廚房地板。

example_en: Winning the championship boosted the team's morale.
example_zh: 贏得冠軍提升了全隊的士氣。

example_en: The film explores the conflict between personal morality and the law.
example_zh: 這部電影探討了個人道德與法律之間的衝突。

example_en: All human beings are mortal.
example_zh: 所有凡人終有一死。

example_en: The bricks were held together by mortar.
example_zh: 這些磚塊是由灰漿粘合在一起的。

example_en: The call to prayer echoed from the mosque.
example_zh: 祈禱的呼召聲從清真寺傳來。

example_en: I was bitten by a mosquito last night.
example_zh: 我昨晚被一隻蚊子叮了。

example_en: A moth flew into the lamp.
example_zh: 一隻飛蛾飛進了燈裡。

example_en: She is enjoying the challenges of motherhood.
example_zh: 她很享受為人母的挑戰。

example_en: I bought a gift for my mom on Mother's Day.
example_zh: 我在母親節買了一份禮物送給我媽媽。

example_en: A good teacher knows how to motivate their students.
example_zh: 一位好的老師知道如何激勵學生。

example_en: The police could not find a motive for the murder.
example_zh: 警方找不到謀殺的動機。

definition_zh: 駕駛汽車的人；汽車司機
example_en: The breakdown caused a delay for motorists on the highway.
example_zh: 車輛拋錨導致高速公路上的駕駛者延誤了時間。

example_en: We drove along the motorway to London.
example_zh: 我們沿著高速公路開車去倫敦。
special_usage: 英式英語用法 (美式英語通常用 highway)

example_en: The school's motto is 'Work hard and play hard'.
example_zh: 學校的格言是『努力工作，盡情玩樂』。
special_usage: 複數形態為 mottos 或 mottoes

example_en: The children piled up a mound of sand on the beach.
example_zh: 孩子們在沙灘上堆起了一個沙堆。

example_en: Switzerland is a beautiful and mountainous country.
example_zh: 瑞士是一個美麗且多山的國家。

example_en: The whole nation mourned the death of the great leader.
example_zh: 舉國上下都在哀悼這位偉大領袖的逝世。

example_en: She let out a mournful cry when she heard the bad news.
example_zh: 聽到這個壞消息時，她發出了一聲悲傷的呼喊。

example_en: He shaved off his moustache before the job interview.
example_zh: 他在面試前刮掉了小鬍子。

definition_zh: 喉舌；代言人；(樂器的) 吹嘴
example_en: The newspaper acted as the mouthpiece for the political party.
example_zh: 該報紙充当了該政黨的喉舌。

example_en: The room is filled with heavy, antique furniture, but the only movable item is the chair.
example_zh: 房間裡滿是沉重的古董家具，唯一可移動的物品是那把椅子。

example_en: He mows the lawn every Saturday morning.
example_zh: 他每週六早晨都會修剪草坪。
special_usage: 過去式為 mowed，過去分詞為 mowed 或 mown

example_en: The gas-powered mower was loud and smoky.
example_zh: 那台汽油動力的割草機既吵鬧又冒煙。

example_en: Good morning, Mr. Smith.
example_zh: 早安，史密斯先生。
special_usage: 用於男性姓氏或全名前，書寫時後方需加句點

definition_zh: 夫人；太太 ( Mistress 的縮寫)
example_en: Mrs. Jones will teach our class next week.
example_zh: 瓊斯夫人下週將教我們的班。
special_usage: 用於已婚女性姓氏前，書寫時後方需加句點

definition_zh: 捷運 (尤指新加坡大眾快速交通系統 Mass Rapid Transit 的縮寫)
example_en: Let's take the MRT to the city center to avoid traffic.
example_zh: 我們搭捷運去市中心吧，以避開交通阻塞。
special_usage: 通常大寫，作為專有名詞

definition_zh: 女士 (用於女性姓氏前，不指明婚姻狀況)
example_en: Ms. Johnson is the new manager of the department.
example_zh: 強斯女士是該部門的新經理。

definition_zh: 多泥的；泥的；泥濘的；渾濁的
example_en: Your boots are all muddy from the garden.
example_zh: 你的靴子在花園裡弄得到處都是泥。

example_en: The farmer used a mule to pull the cart.
example_zh: 農夫用一頭騾子拉車。

example_en: Apple is a large multinational corporation.
example_zh: 蘋果是一家大型跨國公司。

example_en: If you multiply five by ten, you get fifty.
example_zh: 如果你將五乘以十，會得到五十。

example_en: A multitude of people gathered in the square to celebrate the victory.
example_zh: 一群人聚集在廣場上慶祝勝利。
special_usage: A multitude of: 許多的（通常指人）

example_en: He tended to mumble when he was nervous.
example_zh: 他緊張的時候說話總是含含糊糊的。

example_en: The police finally caught the murderer after months of investigation.
example_zh: 經過幾個月的調查，警方終於抓到了那名兇手。

example_en: She murmured sweet words into his ear.
example_zh: 她在他耳邊低語著甜蜜的話語。

example_en: The athlete had a very muscular build.
example_zh: 那位運動員體格非常強壯。

example_en: He sat by the window, musing over the events of the day.
example_zh: 他坐在窗邊，沉思著一天發生的事情。

example_en: The city expanded like a mushroom after the industrial revolution.
example_zh: 該城市在工業革命後像蘑菇般迅速擴張。

example_en: He decided to grow a mustache for the movie role.
example_zh: 他為了那個電影角色決定留八字鬍。

example_en: Could you pass me the mustard, please?
example_zh: 請把芥末遞給我好吗？
special_usage: Hard mustard: 逞強；Hot under the collar: 憤怒（源自芥末的辛辣）

definition_zh: 啞的，不說話的；啞巴；靜音
example_en: The movie was muted so we wouldn't disturb the neighbors.
example_zh: 電影被調成靜音了，以免打擾到鄰居。
special_usage: Mute point: 沒意義的論點（常被誤用，原詞應為 Moo point）

example_en: The old man muttered to himself as he walked down the street.
example_zh: 那位老人沿著街道走時自言自語地抱怨著。

example_en: We had roast mutton for dinner.
example_zh: 我們晚餐吃了烤羊肉。
special_usage: Mutton dressed as lamb: 老來俏（形容打扮過分年輕的中老年女性）

example_en: He is an expert in Greek mythology.
example_zh: 他是希臘神話的專家。

definition_zh: 最低點；天底（對應天頂 Zenith）
example_en: The company's stock price hit its nadir during the recession.
example_zh: 公司的股價在經濟衰退期間跌至最低點。

example_en: Don't nag me about finishing my homework!
example_zh: 不要一直嘮叨我寫作業的事！

example_en: She was too naive to realize he was lying to her.
example_zh: 她太天真了，沒發現他在對她撒謊。

example_en: The nanny took the children to the park every afternoon.
example_zh: 保母每天下午帶孩子們去公園。

example_en: I usually take a short nap after lunch.
example_zh: 我通常在午餐後小睡一下。
special_usage: Catch someone napping: 疏忽，措手不及

example_en: Please hand me a napkin.
example_zh: 請遞給我一張餐巾紙。

example_en: The documentary is narrated by a famous actor.
example_zh: 這部紀錄片由一位著名演員擔任旁白。

example_en: The narrator provided the background information for the story.
example_zh: 敘述者提供了故事的背景資訊。

example_en: His speech was filled with nationalism.
example_zh: 他的演講充滿了民族主義。

definition_zh: 國家主義者/國家主義的
example_en: The nationalist party won the election.
example_zh: 國家主義政黨贏得了選舉。

example_en: Please state your name and nationality.
example_zh: 請說明您的姓名和國籍。

example_en: The naturalist observed the birds in the forest.
example_zh: 這位博物學家在森林中觀察鳥類。

example_en: He pierced his navel.
example_zh: 他穿了肚臍環。

example_en: Without his glasses, he is nearsighted.
example_zh: 不戴眼鏡的話，他是近視的。

example_en: She keeps her room very neat.
example_zh: 她把房間保持得非常整潔。

example_en: The repair will necessitate taking the car apart.
example_zh: 維修將需要把車拆開。

example_en: He wore a red necktie to the party.
example_zh: 他戴了一條紅色領帶去參加派對。

example_en: We should help the needy during the holidays.
example_zh: 我們應該在假期幫助貧困的人。

example_en: He neglected his duty.
example_zh: 他疏忽了他的職責。

example_en: The damage to the car was negligible.
example_zh: 車子的損壞微不足道。

example_en: The two sides are trying to negotiate a deal.
example_zh: 雙方正試圖協商一筆交易。

example_en: The negotiator managed to resolve the conflict.
example_zh: 談判者成功解決了衝突。

example_en: We visited the neighboring town.
example_zh: 我們拜訪了鄰近的城鎮。

example_en: My nephew is five years old.
example_zh: 我的侄子五歲了。

example_en: New Year's Day is a public holiday.
example_zh: 元旦是個國定假日。

example_en: We stay up late on New Year's Eve.
example_zh: 我們在除夕夜熬夜守歲。

example_en: The newcomer was nervous on his first day.
example_zh: 新來的人在第一天很緊張。

example_en: The newlyweds went on a honeymoon.
example_zh: 新婚夫婦去度蜜月了。

example_en: I watched the morning newscast.
example_zh: 我看了早晨的新聞廣播。

example_en: The newscaster announced the results of the election.
example_zh: 新聞播音員宣佈了選舉結果。

example_en: We watched a newsreel from the 1940s in history class.
example_zh: 我們在歷史課上觀看了1940年代的新聞短片。

example_en: The rabbit nibbled on the carrot.
example_zh: 兔子小口啃著胡蘿蔔。

example_en: She bought a nice-looking dress for the party.
example_zh: 她為派對買了一件好看的洋裝。

example_en: My niece is three years old and very energetic.
example_zh: 我的姪女三歲了，精力非常旺盛。

example_en: They went to a nightclub to celebrate their anniversary.
example_zh: 他們去夜總會慶祝結婚紀念日。

example_en: The song of the nightingale filled the garden.
example_zh: 夜鶯的歌聲充滿了花園。

example_en: There are nineteen students in the classroom.
example_zh: 教室裡有十九位學生。

example_en: My grandfather is ninety years old.
example_zh: 我的祖父九十歲了。

example_en: He nodded his head in agreement.
example_zh: 他點頭表示同意。

example_en: The children were very noisy during the lesson.
example_zh: 孩子們在上課期間非常吵鬧。

example_en: He pays only a nominal rent to live there.
example_zh: 他住在那裡只付象徵性的租金。

example_en: She was nominated for the Best Actress award.
example_zh: 她被提名為最佳女主角。

example_en: The nominees for the award were announced today.
example_zh: 該獎項的候選人名單今天公佈了。

example_en: It was raining; nonetheless, we went for a walk.
example_zh: 下雨了；儘管如此，我們還是去散步了。

example_en: Don't talk nonsense! You know that's not true.
example_zh: 別胡說！你知道那不是真的。
special_usage: 常見片語：make nonsense of (使...變得毫無意義)

example_en: We took a nonstop flight to London.
example_zh: 我們搭直達航班去倫敦。

example_en: The protest was organized as a nonviolent demonstration.
example_zh: 這次抗議被組織成一場非暴力的示威活動。

example_en: I love eating beef noodles for lunch.
example_zh: 我午餐喜歡吃牛肉麵。

example_en: He pinched his nostrils shut before diving into the water.
example_zh: 他在潛入水中前捏住了鼻孔。

example_en: The author is notable for her mystery novels.
example_zh: 這位作家以她的推理小說而聞名。

example_en: The region is notably drier than it was last year.
example_zh: 該地區比去年乾燥得多，值得注意。

example_en: Musical notation was developed to help musicians read music.
example_zh: 音樂記譜法是為了幫助音樂家讀譜而發展的。

example_en: There is a noticeable difference in quality between the two products.
example_zh: 這兩種產品的質量有顯著差異。

definition_zh: 聲名狼藉的，臭名昭著的
example_en: The area is notorious for its heavy traffic jams.
example_zh: 該地區因嚴重的交通堵塞而臭名昭著。

example_en: They decided to proceed, notwithstanding the risks involved.
example_zh: 儘管存在風險，他們還是決定繼續進行。
special_usage: 正式用語，同義詞為 despite 或 although。

example_en: In 'the dog ran', 'dog' is a noun.
example_zh: 在 'the dog ran' 中，'dog' 是一個名詞。

example_en: The soil needs to be nourished with organic matter.
example_zh: 土壤需要有機質來滋養。

example_en: She is a famous novelist known for her historical fiction.
example_zh: 她是一位著名的小說家，以歷史小說聞名。

example_en: The course is designed for both experts and novices.
example_zh: 這門課程是為專家和新手設計的。

example_en: Nowadays, most people own a smartphone.
example_zh: 現今，大多數人都擁有一部智慧型手機。
special_usage: 通常用於口語或非正式文體。

example_en: The nucleus is the control center of the cell.
example_zh: 細胞核是細胞的控制中心。

example_en: Mosquitoes can be a real nuisance in the summer.
example_zh: 夏天裡，蚊子真的很討厭。

example_en: The nun lives in a convent.
example_zh: 那位修女住在修道院裡。

example_en: It is important to nurture the talents of young students.
example_zh: 培養年輕學生的才華很重要。

example_en: Plants absorb nutrients from the soil.
example_zh: 植物從土壤中吸收養分。

example_en: You should eat a balanced and nutritious diet.
example_zh: 你應該吃均衡且有營養的飲食。

example_en: He pulled the oars to move the boat forward.
example_zh: 他划動船槳讓船前進。

example_en: The witness was placed under oath to tell the truth.
example_zh: 證人被要求宣誓說實話。

example_en: I usually eat oatmeal for breakfast.
example_zh: 我早餐通常吃燕麥片。

example_en: Soldiers must show obedience to their commanders.
example_zh: 士兵必須服從指揮官的命令。

example_en: The dog was very obedient and followed all commands.
example_zh: 這隻狗非常聽話，執行了所有的指令。

example_en: Soldiers are expected to obey orders without question.
example_zh: 士兵應該毫不猶豫地服從命令。

example_en: The local newspaper published an obituary for the late professor.
example_zh: 當地報紙刊登了這位已故教授的訃聞。

example_en: The defense lawyer raised an objection to the prosecutor's question.
example_zh: 辯護律師對檢察官的提問提出了異議。

example_en: The contract obligates him to work for the company for two years.
example_zh: 這份合約使他有義務為公司工作兩年。
special_usage: 常以被動形式 'be obligated' 出現

example_en: Helmets are obligatory for cyclists in this city.
example_zh: 在這座城市，騎腳踏車戴安全帽是強制性的。

example_en: Could you oblige me by closing the window?
example_zh: 能不能麻煩你幫我把窗戶關上？
special_usage: 常用片語: 'be obliged to do' (不得不做)

example_en: The dining table is oblong, seating six people comfortably.
example_zh: 這張餐桌是長方形的，可以舒適地容納六個人。

example_en: The network was fined for broadcasting obscene language during daytime.
example_zh: 該電視網因在白天播放髒話而被罰款。

example_en: The meaning of the poem was obscure to me.
example_zh: 這首詩的含義對我來說太晦澀了。

example_en: He began to obsess over his appearance.
example_zh: 他開始過度在意自己的外表。
special_usage: 常用被動形式 'be obsessed with'

example_en: He has an obsession with cleanliness.
example_zh: 他有潔癖。

example_en: Lack of funding is the biggest obstacle to our progress.
example_zh: 缺乏資金是我們進展中最大的障礙。

example_en: He is obstinate in his refusal to admit the truth.
example_zh: 他固執地拒絕承認事實。

example_en: These books occupy too much space on the desk.
example_zh: 這些書佔據了桌上太多空間。
special_usage: 形容詞形式: 'occupied' (忙碌的；已被佔用的)

example_en: I will meet you at 3 o'clock.
example_zh: 我會在三點鐘與你碰面。

example_en: The octopus can change its color to camouflage itself.
example_zh: 章魚可以改變顏色來偽裝自己。

example_en: There is a strange odor coming from the basement.
example_zh: 地下室傳來一股奇怪的氣味。

example_en: I didn't mean to offend you with my comments.
example_zh: 我不是故意用我的言論冒犯你的。

example_en: Their offspring have all moved away from home.
example_zh: 他們的子女都已經搬離了家。
special_usage: 單複數同形 (One offspring / Many offspring)

example_en: My grandmother uses an old-fashioned rotary phone.
example_zh: 我祖母使用一種老式的轉盤電話。

example_en: Please do not omit any details in your report.
example_zh: 請不要在你的報告中省略任何細節。

example_en: One should take care of oneself.
example_zh: 一個人應該照顧自己。

example_en: The report was criticized for being one-sided.
example_zh: 這份報告因片面而受到批評。

example_en: This is a one-time offer.
example_zh: 這是一次性的優惠。

example_en: The glass was opaque, so we couldn't see inside.
example_zh: 玻璃是不透明的，我們無法看到裡面。

example_en: He used a can opener to open the soup.
example_zh: 他用開罐器打開了湯。

example_en: She openly admitted her mistakes.
example_zh: 她公開承認了自己的錯誤。

example_en: The new law is now operative.
example_zh: 新法律現已生效。
special_usage: 作名詞時可指「特工人員」或「手術病人」。

example_en: Many citizens oppose the new tax.
example_zh: 許多市民反對新的稅收。

example_en: The regime oppressed the people.
example_zh: 該政權壓迫人民。

example_en: They fought against oppression.
example_zh: 他們反抗壓迫。

example_en: She has a great deal of optimism about the future.
example_zh: 她對未來充滿了極大的樂觀。

example_en: He is optimistic about his chances of winning.
example_zh: 他對贏的機會感到樂觀。

example_en: We walked through the apple orchard.
example_zh: 我們走過了蘋果園。

example_en: Surviving the earthquake was a terrible ordeal.
example_zh: 在地震中倖存是一場可怕的磨難。

example_en: The books were kept in an orderly fashion.
example_zh: 書籍擺放得整整齊齊。

example_en: Iron ore is used to make steel.
example_zh: 鐵礦石用來煉鋼。

example_en: Bacteria are microscopic organisms.
example_zh: 細菌是微小的生物。

example_en: We need to orient our strategy towards the new market.
example_zh: 我們需要將戰略方向調整至新市場。

example_en: Her work is full of originality.
example_zh: 她的作品充滿了創意。

example_en: The custom originated in China.
example_zh: 這個習俗起源於中國。

example_en: She wore a silver ornament around her neck.
example_zh: 她脖子上戴著一個銀飾品。

example_en: The war left many children as orphans.
example_zh: 戰爭讓許多孩子成了孤兒。

example_en: He was raised in an orphanage after his parents passed away.
example_zh: 父母去世後，他在孤兒院長大。

example_en: She has very orthodox views on marriage.
example_zh: 她對婚姻有非常傳統的看法。
special_usage: 常指宗教信仰或傳統習慣

example_en: The ostrich is the largest bird in the world.
example_zh: 鴕鳥是世界上最大的鳥。

example_en: Add a few ounces of cream to the sauce.
example_zh: 在醬汁裡加一點點鮮奶油。

example_en: The board voted to oust the chairman.
example_zh: 董事會投票罷黜了董事長。

example_en: The government is trying to contain the outbreak of the virus.
example_zh: 政府正試圖遏制病毒的爆發。

example_en: He studied hard to outdo his older brother.
example_zh: 他努力學習以超越他的哥哥。

example_en: She wore a beautiful outfit to the party.
example_zh: 她穿了一套漂亮的服裝去參加派對。

example_en: She has a very outgoing personality.
example_zh: 她性格非常外向。
special_usage: 也可指即將卸任的（如 outgoing president）

example_en: The family went on an outing to the beach.
example_zh: 全家去海邊郊遊。

example_en: Robin Hood was a famous outlaw.
example_zh: 羅賓漢是著名的歹徒。
special_usage: 亦可作動詞，意為 '宣布...為非法'

example_en: Female students outnumber male students at this school.
example_zh: 這所學校的女學生比男學生多。

example_en: The decision caused public outrage.
example_zh: 這項決定引起了公眾的憤怒。

example_en: That restaurant's prices are outrageous.
example_zh: 那家餐廳的價格貴得太離譜了。

example_en: I refused his offer outright.
example_zh: 我斷然拒絕了他的提議。

example_en: We must explain the rules at the outset.
example_zh: 我們必須在開頭就解釋規則。
special_usage: 常用片語 from the outset（從一開始）

example_en: He felt like an outsider in the new city.
example_zh: 在這座新城市裡，他感覺自己是個局外人。

example_en: They live on the outskirts of London.
example_zh: 他們住在倫敦郊區。

example_en: Although he was calm on the outward, he was nervous inside.
example_zh: 雖然外表上他很冷靜，但內心很緊張。

example_en: It's cold outside, so don't forget your overcoat.
example_zh: 外面很冷，別忘了帶你的大衣。

example_en: Don't overdo it with the spices.
example_zh: 不要把香料放得太多。

example_en: I tend to overeat during the holidays.
example_zh: 我在假期期間傾向於暴飲暴食。

example_zh: 一名行人在斑馬線上過馬路。

example_zh: 圖書館訂閱了一份科學期刊。
special_usage: 亦可作為形容詞，意為「定期的」。

example_en: Many animals perish in the forest fire.
example_zh: 許多動物在森林大火中喪生。

example_zh: 烹飪的氣味瀰漫在走廊中。

example_zh: 請帶上所有相關文件來開會。

example_zh: 小貓正處於愛玩耍的狀態。

example_zh: 他懇求父母讓他去。

example_zh: 「children」這個字是「child」的複數形式。

example_zh: 她把錢放在一個皮革皮夾裡。

definition_zh: 泰然自若的；擺好姿勢的

example_zh: 這部電影將那位歷史人物刻畫得非常富有同情心。
