example_zh: 龍捲風摧毀了小鎮上的幾間房子。

example_en: The heavy rain caused the stream to swell into a raging torrent.
example_zh: 大雨導致溪流暴漲成洶湧的激流。

example_en: The tortoise moved slowly but steadily across the path.
example_zh: 陸龜緩慢但平穩地穿過小徑。

example_en: He decided to toss the ball to his friend.
example_zh: 他決定把球拋給他的朋友。

example_en: The movie had a touching ending that made everyone cry.
example_zh: 這部電影有個感人的結局，讓所有人都哭了。

example_en: She is very touchy about her past, so don't bring it up.
example_zh: 她對自己的過去非常敏感，所以不要提起。

example_en: The broken car had to be towed to the garage.
example_zh: 那輛壞掉的車必須被拖到修車廠。

example_en: After the swim, he dried himself with a towel.
example_zh: 游泳後，他用毛巾擦乾身體。

example_en: I got a good discount on the new phone because of my trade-in.
example_zh: 因為折價購入舊手機，我在新手機上獲得了很好的折扣。
special_usage: 指以舊換新的交易方式

example_en: There is a trade-off between price and quality.
example_zh: 價格和質量之間需要權衡。

example_en: It was a tragic accident that claimed many lives.
example_zh: 這是一場奪走許多寶貴生命的悲慘意外。

example_en: The new trainee is learning the ropes quickly.
example_zh: 新來的實習生學得很快。

example_en: Honesty is one of her best traits.
example_zh: 誠實是她最好的特質之一。

example_en: He was branded a traitor after revealing state secrets.
example_zh: 在洩露國家機密後，他被視為叛徒。

example_en: The general was accused of traitorous behavior.
example_zh: 將軍被指控有背叛行為。

example_en: The tramp slept on the park bench.
example_zh: 流浪漢睡在公園的長椅上。

example_en: Please don't trample on the grass.
example_zh: 請勿踐踏草地。

example_en: The lake was tranquil in the early morning.
example_zh: 清晨時分，湖面十分平靜。

example_en: The vet had to tranquilize the aggressive dog.
example_zh: 獸醫必須讓那隻兇猛的狗鎮靜下來。

example_en: The doctor prescribed a mild tranquilizer for her anxiety.
example_zh: 醫生給她開了一種溫和的鎮靜劑來治療焦慮。

example_en: Her talent transcends the boundaries of mere description.
example_zh: 她的才華超越了單純的文字描述。

example_en: The views from the summit were simply transcendent.
example_zh: 從山頂眺望的景色實在是超凡脫俗。

example_en: Please transcribe the audio recording into written text.
example_zh: 請將這段錄音轉錄成文字。

example_en: The electrical transformer is located behind the building.
example_zh: 電力變壓器位於大樓後方。

example_en: The feeling of joy was only transient, quickly replaced by worry.
example_zh: 喜悅的感覺只是短暫的，很快就被憂慮取代了。

example_en: The invention of the transistor revolutionized electronics.
example_zh: 晶體管的發明徹底改變了電子工業。

example_en: The doctors managed to transplant the kidney successfully.
example_zh: 醫生成功地移植了腎臟。

example_en: He struggled to recover from the traumatic accident.
example_zh: 他努力從那場創傷性的事故中恢復過來。

example_en: It took them three days to traverse the dense forest.
example_zh: 他們花了三天時間才穿越茂密的森林。

example_en: The path became treacherous after the heavy rain.
example_zh: 大雨過後，這條路變得非常危險。

example_en: Please wipe your feet before you tread on the carpet.
example_zh: 踏上地毯前，請先擦擦腳。

example_en: He was charged with treason for selling secrets to the enemy.
example_zh: 他因向敵人出售機密而被控叛國罪。

example_en: Her hands trembled as she opened the letter.
example_zh: 她打開信封時，雙手在顫抖。

example_en: A slight tremor was felt in the building during the quake.
example_zh: 地震時，大樓裡感覺到了輕微的震動。

example_en: The workers dug a trench to lay the pipes.
example_zh: 工人挖了一條溝渠來鋪設管道。

example_en: It is illegal to trespass on private property.
example_zh: 擅自進入私人領地是違法的。

example_en: This is a tricky question; think carefully before answering.
example_zh: 這是個棘手的問題，回答前要仔細思考。

example_en: Don't get angry over such a trifle.
example_zh: 不要為這點小事生氣。

example_en: The star is trillions of miles away from Earth.
example_zh: 那顆恆星距離地球數萬億英里遠。

example_en: The team returned to the city feeling triumphant.
example_zh: 隊伍凱旋歸來，充滿了勝利的喜悅。

example_en: They argued about trivial matters all evening.
example_zh: 他們整晚都在為雞毛蒜皮的小事爭吵。

example_en: She pushed the shopping trolley to the checkout.
example_zh: 她推著購物車走向收銀台。

example_en: The army sent in extra troops.
example_zh: 軍隊派出了額外的部隊。

example_en: He won the gold trophy in the competition.
example_zh: 他在比賽中贏得了金牌獎盃。

example_en: Bananas grow well in the tropics.
example_zh: 香蕉在熱帶地區生長得很好。
special_usage: 常以複數形式 'tropics' 指代熱帶

example_en: The horse trotted across the field.
example_zh: 那匹馬小跑著穿過田野。

example_en: This lock is very troublesome to open.
example_zh: 這把鎖很難打開，很麻煩。

example_en: He bought a new pair of trousers.
example_zh: 他買了一條新褲子。
special_usage: 通常視為單數，但須搭配量詞 'pair' 使用

example_en: The school is trying to reduce the number of truants.
example_zh: 學校試圖減少逃學者的數量。

example_en: The two countries agreed to a truce.
example_zh: 兩國同意休戰。

example_en: He played a melody on the trumpet.
example_zh: 他用小號吹奏了一首曲子。
special_usage: 亦可作動詞，意為『大力宣揚』

example_en: She is a very truthful person.
example_zh: 她是個非常誠實的人。

example_en: He wore a blue t-shirt and jeans.
example_zh: 他穿了一件藍色 T 恤和牛仔褲。

example_en: TB is a serious infectious disease.
example_zh: 肺結核是一種嚴重的傳染病。

example_en: She tucked the blanket around the child.
example_zh: 她把毯子塞緊蓋住孩子。

example_en: He tugged at the heavy suitcase.
example_zh: 他用力拉那個沉重的手提箱。

example_en: We played tug-of-war at the picnic.
example_zh: 我們在野餐時玩了拔河。
special_usage: 亦可形容雙方激烈的爭奪

example_en: The garden is full of colorful tulips.
example_zh: 花園裡開滿了五顏六色的鬱金香。

example_en: The child tumbled down the hill.
example_zh: 小孩從山坡上滾了下來。

example_en: I had a tuna sandwich for lunch.
example_zh: 我午餐吃了一個鮪魚三明治。
special_usage: 複數可為 tuna 或 tunas

example_en: The power plant uses a steam turbine.
example_zh: 發電廠使用蒸汽渦輪機。

example_en: The sea was too turbulent for sailing.
example_zh: 海面太洶湧，無法航行。

example_en: The country was in a state of turmoil.
example_zh: 該國處於混亂狀態。

definition_zh: 營業額；人員流動率；翻轉
example_en: The company's annual turnover exceeded one million dollars.
example_zh: 該公司的年度營業額超過一百萬美元。

definition_zh: 家庭教師；指導教師；輔導
example_en: She hired a tutor to help her prepare for the exam.
example_zh: 她請了一位家庭教師來幫忙準備考試。

example_en: The bird picked up a twig to build its nest.
example_zh: 那隻鳥撿起一根細枝來築巢。

example_en: The sky was a beautiful purple at twilight.
example_zh: 黃昏時分，天空呈現美麗的紫色。

example_en: I saw the stars twinkle in the night sky.
example_zh: 我看見星星在夜空中閃爍。

example_en: Two-thirds of the students passed the test.
example_zh: 三分之二的學生通過了測驗。

example_en: My grandfather still uses an old typewriter.
example_zh: 我的祖父仍然使用一台舊打字機。

example_en: The typhoon caused severe damage to the coastal city.
example_zh: 颱風對沿海城市造成了嚴重損害。
special_usage: 專指太平洋地區的颶風

example_en: She works as a secretary and typist.
example_zh: 她的工作是秘書兼打字員。

example_en: The people rebelled against the tyranny of the dictator.
example_zh: 人民反抗獨裁者的暴政。

example_en: The tyrant ruled the country with an iron fist.
example_zh: 暴君以鐵腕統治這個國家。

example_en: He was diagnosed with a stomach ulcer.
example_zh: 他被診斷出患有胃潰瘍。

example_en: Wear sunscreen to protect your skin from ultraviolet rays.
example_zh: 塗抹防曬乳以保護皮膚免受紫外線傷害。

example_en: Don't forget to bring your umbrella, it's raining.
example_zh: 別忘了帶傘，外面正在下雨。

example_en: The umpire called the runner out.
example_zh: 裁判判跑者出局。

definition_zh: 不能接受的；不令人滿意的
example_en: His behavior towards the customers was unacceptable.
example_zh: 他對顧客的態度是不可接受的。

example_en: The committee made a unanimous decision.
example_zh: 委員會做出了一致的決定。

definition_zh: 未被擊敗的；未被打破的
example_en: The champion remained unbeaten for three years.
example_zh: 這位冠軍保持三年不敗。
special_usage: 常用於體育賽事或紀錄

example_en: The house has remained unchanged since the 1950s.
example_zh: 這棟房子自 1950 年代以來一直保持原狀。

example_en: The kidnappers demanded an unconditional surrender.
example_zh: 綁架者要求無條件投降。
special_usage: 常用片語：unconditional love (無條件的愛)

example_en: Journalists uncovered the corruption scandal.
example_zh: 記者揭露了貪污醜聞。

example_en: You should not underestimate the difficulty of the task.
example_zh: 你不應該低估這項任務的難度。

example_en: Patients must undergo a series of medical tests.
example_zh: 病人必須經歷一系列的醫療檢查。

example_en: The economic issues underlie many social problems.
example_zh: 經濟問題構成了許多社會問題的基礎。

example_en: The report underlines the importance of education.
example_zh: 這份報告強調了教育的重要性。

example_en: Lack of trust can undermine a relationship.
example_zh: 缺乏信任會破壞一段關係。

example_en: He found his keys underneath the sofa.
example_zh: 他在沙發底下找到了鑰匙。

example_en: Pedestrians should use the underpass to cross the road safely.
example_zh: 行人應使用地下道安全穿越馬路。

example_en: His anger is understandable given the circumstances.
example_zh: 考慮到這種情況，他的憤怒是可以理解的。

example_en: The submarine traveled underwater.
example_zh: 潛水艇在水下行駛。

example_en: Preparations for the event are already underway.
example_zh: 活動的準備工作已經在進行中了。
special_usage: 常作表語使用，通常不置於名詞前 (Predicative adjective)

example_en: The doctor said I am slightly underweight.
example_zh: 醫生說我有點體重不足。

example_en: The bank agreed to underwrite the loan.
example_zh: 銀行同意承擔這筆貸款的風險。

example_en: She is an undisputed, undoubted talent.
example_zh: 她是公認的、無可置疑的人才。

definition_zh: 不安的；焦慮的；不自在的
example_en: I felt uneasy about the silence in the room.
example_zh: 房間裡的寂靜讓我感到不安。

example_en: Many people became unemployed during the recession.
example_zh: 許多在經濟衰退期間失業了。

example_en: The story unfolded slowly as we read the book.
example_zh: 隨著我們閱讀這本書，故事慢慢展開。

definition_zh: 未被識別的；身份不明的
example_en: Police are looking for an unidentified suspect.
example_zh: 警方正在尋找一名身份不明的嫌疑人。

example_en: The unification of the two countries changed the map of Europe.
example_zh: 這兩個國家的統一改變了歐洲地圖。

example_en: It is difficult to unify different cultures.
example_zh: 統一不同的文化是很困難的。

example_en: The tragedy united the community.
example_zh: 這場悲劇讓社區團結了起來。

example_en: The storm unleashed its fury on the coast.
example_zh: 暴風雨猛烈地襲擊了海岸。

example_en: The workers began to unload the truck.
example_zh: 工人開始卸下卡車上的貨物。

example_en: I need to unpack my suitcases after the trip.
example_zh: 旅行結束後，我需要打開行李箱整理東西。

example_en: The company experienced unprecedented growth last year.
example_zh: 該公司去年經歷了前所未有的增長。

example_en: Political unrest has affected the region's economy.
example_zh: 政治動盪影響了該地區的經濟。

example_en: The dessert remained untouched on the table.
example_zh: 桌上的甜點完全沒有被碰過。

example_en: It is unusually cold for this time of year.
example_zh: 就這個季節而言，天氣異常地冷。

example_en: The artist will unveil her latest sculpture tomorrow.
example_zh: 這位藝術家將於明天揭幕她的最新雕塑作品。

definition_zh: 不需要的；多餘的；不受歡迎的
example_en: He threw away the unwanted junk mail.
example_zh: 他把不需要的垃圾郵件丟掉了。

example_en: She had a strict upbringing.
example_zh: 她的家教很嚴。

example_en: It is the duty of the court to uphold the law.
example_zh: 維護法律是法庭的職責。

example_en: He is an upright citizen who always follows the rules.
example_zh: 他是個正直的公民，總是遵守規則。
special_usage: 亦可作副詞，意為「垂直地」。

example_en: The peasants staged an uprising against the king.
example_zh: 農民發動了一場反抗國王的起義。

example_en: My bedroom is upstairs.
example_zh: 我的臥室在樓上。
special_usage: 亦可作名詞，指「樓上的一層」。

definition_zh: 最新的；現代的；包含最新資訊的
example_en: This software is up-to-date.
example_zh: 這個軟體是最新的版本。

example_en: The rocket's upward trajectory was steep.
example_zh: 火箭的上升軌跡很陡峭。
special_usage: 亦可作副詞 (upwards)，意為「向上地」。

definition_zh: 鈾（一種放射性金屬元素）
example_en: Uranium is used to generate nuclear power.
example_zh: 鈾被用來發電核能。

example_en: There is a sense of urgency to finish the project on time.
example_zh: 有種必須按時完成專案的急迫感。

example_en: The doctor asked for a urine sample.
example_zh: 醫生要求提供尿液樣本。

example_en: This old phone is useless now.
example_zh: 這支舊手機現在已經沒用了。

example_en: The usher showed us to our seats.
example_zh: 引座員帶我們到座位上。
special_usage: 亦可作動詞，意為「引領；招待」。

definition_zh: 器具；用具（尤指廚房用具）
example_en: Please wash the cooking utensils.
example_zh: 請清洗烹飪用具。

example_en: She trusted him to the utmost.
example_zh: 她極度信任他。

example_en: He didn't utter a single word.
example_zh: 他一句話也沒說。
special_usage: 作形容詞時意為「完全的」，如 in utter darkness（在完全的黑暗中）。

example_en: We have a vacancy for a receptionist.
example_zh: 我們前台接待員有一個空缺。

definition_zh: 空的；未被佔用的；茫然的
example_en: Is this seat vacant?
example_zh: 這個座位是空的嗎？

example_en: I have a vague memory of meeting her.
example_zh: 我隱約記得見過她。

example_en: He made a vain attempt to save the company.
example_zh: 他為了挽救公司做了一次徒勞的嘗試。
special_usage: 片語 in vain 意為「徒勞、白費力氣」。

example_en: He bought roses for Valentine's Day.
example_zh: 他在情人節買了玫瑰花。

example_en: They made a valiant effort to finish on time.
example_zh: 他們為了準時完成付出了英勇的努力。

example_en: The magician vanished into thin air.
example_zh: 魔術師憑空消失了。

example_en: His vanity prevents him from admitting his mistakes.
example_zh: 他的虛榮心讓他無法承認錯誤。

example_en: A cloud is a mass of vapor in the atmosphere.
example_zh: 雲是大氣中的一團水汽。
special_usage: 美式拼寫；英式拼寫為 vapour。

example_en: She put fresh flowers in the vase.
example_zh: 她把鮮花插在花瓶裡。

example_en: The bride wore a white veil.
example_zh: 新娘戴著白色的面紗。
special_usage: 片語 a veil of secrecy 意為「神秘的面紗」。

example_en: The doctor drew blood from the vein in his arm.
example_zh: 醫生從他手臂的靜脈抽血。
special_usage: In a... vein 指「以...的語氣/心情」。

example_en: Vending machines sell snacks and drinks.
example_zh: 自動販賣機出售零食和飲料。
special_usage: 通常用於法律或正式文書；常見於 vending machine（自動販賣機）。

example_en: He vented his anger on the innocent bystander.
example_zh: 他把怒氣發洩在無辜的旁觀者身上。
special_usage: Give vent to 意為「洩露/表達（情緒）」。

example_en: Open the windows to ventilate the room.
example_zh: 打開窗戶讓房間通風。

example_en: 'Run' is a verb.
example_zh: Run 是一個動詞。

example_en: The jury reached a guilty verdict.
example_zh: 陪審團達成了有罪的裁決。

example_en: She was on the verge of tears.
example_zh: 她處於崩潰的邊緣（快哭了）。
special_usage: 片語 on the verge of 意為「瀕臨、在...的邊緣」。

example_en: Leather is a versatile material.
example_zh: 皮革是一種多用途的材料。

example_en: He wore a warm vest under his jacket.
example_zh: 他在夾克下穿了一件保暖背心。
special_usage: also a verb meaning to confer or give (rights or authority)

example_en: We took our sick dog to the veterinarian.
example_zh: 我們把生病的狗帶去看獸醫。
special_usage: often shortened to 'vet' in informal speech

example_en: The president decided to veto the bill.
example_zh: 總統決定否決這項法案。
special_usage: implies the power to stop a decision or proposal

example_en: Your business plan sounds viable and profitable.
example_zh: 你的商業計劃聽起來可行且有利可圖。
special_usage: often used regarding plans, solutions, or biological matter

example_en: The phone began to vibrate on the table.
example_zh: 桌上的手機開始震動。

example_en: I felt a vibration coming from the engine.
example_zh: 我感覺到引擎傳來的震動。
special_usage: often refers to a rhythmic shaking movement

example_en: The vicar delivered a sermon on Sunday.
example_zh: 教區牧師在週日進行了佈道。
special_usage: specific to the Church of England or Roman Catholic context

example_en: The vice president will take over if the president is unable to serve.
example_zh: 如果總統無法任職，副總統將接任。

example_en: There are no shops in the immediate vicinity.
example_zh: 在附近一帶沒有商店。
special_usage: formal tone; usually refers to the area around a specific point

example_en: The dog became vicious when provoked.
example_zh: 那隻狗被激怒時變得十分兇猛。
special_usage: implies intent to harm or extreme violence

example_en: He felt that he was being victimized because of his beliefs.
example_zh: 他覺得自己因為信仰而受害。
special_usage: often implies singling someone out unfairly

example_en: The victorious team celebrated their win.
example_zh: 獲勝的隊伍慶祝他們的勝利。

example_en: From my viewpoint, we should wait before deciding.
example_zh: 依我看，我們應該等待再做決定。

example_en: He tackled the job with great vigor.
example_zh: 他以巨大的活力投入這份工作。
special_usage: often implies physical strength and good health

example_en: She does vigorous exercise three times a week.
example_zh: 她每週做三次劇烈運動。

example_en: The villagers gathered in the town square.
example_zh: 村民們聚集在鎮廣場上。

example_en: The villain tried to destroy the city.
example_zh: 反派試圖摧毀城市。
special_usage: can refer to a criminal or a character in a story

example_en: Grapes grow on a vine.
example_zh: 葡萄生長在藤蔓上。

example_en: I added some vinegar to the salad dressing.
example_zh: 我在沙拉醬里加了些醋。
special_usage: often used in cooking or cleaning

example_en: They toured the famous vineyard in France.
example_zh: 他們參觀了法國著名的葡萄園。
special_usage: specific to land used for growing grapes

example_en: You are not allowed to violate the rules.
example_zh: 你不允許違反規則。
special_usage: can refer to breaking a law, invading privacy, or disrespecting

example_en: She wore a beautiful dress in shades of violet.
example_zh: 她穿了一件紫羅蘭色調的漂亮裙子。

example_en: The young violinist played the concerto flawlessly.
example_zh: 那位年輕的小提琴家完美地演奏了協奏曲。

example_en: Try to visualize yourself crossing the finish line.
example_zh: 試著想像你自己越過終點線。

example_en: The city is full of vitality and energy.
example_zh: 這座城市充滿了活力與能量。

example_en: I still have a vivid memory of my first day of school.
example_zh: 我對第一天上學仍有著鮮明的記憶。

example_en: He felt that medicine was his true vocation.
example_zh: 他覺得當醫生是他真正的使命。

example_en: The vogue for tiny phones seems to be returning.
example_zh: 迷你手機的流行似乎正在回潮。

example_en: The political situation in the region remains volatile.
example_zh: 該地區的政治局勢仍然不穩定。

example_en: The volcano erupted, sending ash into the atmosphere.
example_zh: 火山爆發，將火山灰噴向大氣層。

example_en: He felt sick and began to vomit.
example_zh: 他感到噁心並開始嘔吐。

example_en: Every voter should exercise their right to vote.
example_zh: 每位選民都應該行使其投票權。

example_en: I got a voucher for a free meal at the restaurant.
example_zh: 我拿到一張那家餐廳的免費餐券。

example_en: They made a vow to love each other forever.
example_zh: 他們立誓要永遠相愛。

example_en: The letters A, E, I, O, U are vowels.
example_zh: 字母 A、E、I、O、U 是元音。

example_en: The voyage across the Atlantic took seven days.
example_zh: 橫渡大西洋的航行花了七天時間。

example_en: He was criticized for his vulgar language.
example_zh: 他因使用粗俗的語言而受到批評。

example_en: We had to wade across the shallow river.
example_zh: 我們必須涉水過那條淺河。
special_usage: wade through (費力地閱讀或處理)

example_en: The dog wagged its tail happily.
example_zh: 那隻狗高興地搖著尾巴。

example_en: The wind wailed through the trees.
example_zh: 風在樹林中呼嘯而過。

example_en: He put his arm around her waist.
example_zh: 他用手臂摟住她的腰。

example_en: The waiter brought us the check.
example_zh: 服務生給我們拿來了帳單。

example_en: The waitress brought us our drinks quickly.
example_zh: 女服務生很快地給我們送來了飲料。

example_en: The loud noise wakened me from my sleep.
example_zh: 巨大的聲響將我從睡夢中喚醒。

example_en: They danced a beautiful waltz at the ball.
example_zh: 他們在舞會上跳了一支優美的華爾滋。

example_en: We like to wander through the old streets of the city.
example_zh: 我們喜歡在城市的古老街道上漫步。

example_en: She updated her wardrobe for the new season.
example_zh: 她為了新一季更新了衣櫃裡的衣物。

example_en: Modern warfare often involves advanced technology.
example_zh: 現代戰爭通常涉及先進的科技。

example_en: We sat near the fire to enjoy the warmth.
example_zh: 我們坐在火爐旁享受溫暖。

example_en: The weather forecast warned of heavy rain.
example_zh: 天氣預報警告有大雨。

example_en: The two warring factions finally agreed to a ceasefire.
example_zh: 兩個交戰派系終於同意停火。

example_en: The navy sent a warship to patrol the area.
example_zh: 海軍派了一艘軍艦去巡邏該區域。

example_en: Life was difficult for civilians during wartime.
example_zh: 在戰時，平民的生活很艱難。

example_en: He was wary of strangers offering him money.
example_zh: 他對給他錢的陌生人很謹慎。

example_en: The watchman patrolled the building at night.
example_zh: 守夜人在夜間巡邏大樓。

example_en: We hiked up the mountain to see the waterfall.
example_zh: 我們徒步上山去看瀑布。

example_en: This watermelon is very sweet and juicy.
example_zh: 這個西瓜又甜又多汁。

example_en: Make sure the container is watertight before you put it in the boat.
example_zh: 在把它放進船裡之前，確保容器是防水的。
special_usage: 也可指論點「無懈可擊的」

example_en: His way-out ideas were not accepted by the committee.
example_zh: 他那些怪誕的想法沒有被委員會接受。

example_en: Lack of sleep will weaken your immune system.
example_zh: 睡眠不足會削弱你的免疫系統。

example_en: Chocolate is my only weakness.
example_zh: 巧克力是我唯一的弱點。

example_en: She comes from a wealthy family.
example_zh: 她來自一個富有的家庭。

example_en: After the long journey, he felt weary.
example_zh: 長途旅行後，他感到疲倦。

example_en: She knows how to weave a beautiful scarf.
example_zh: 她知道如何編織一條漂亮的圍巾。

example_en: He used a wedge to keep the door open.
example_zh: 他用楔子讓門保持開著。

example_en: I need just a wee bit of sugar for my tea.
example_zh: 我的茶只需要一點點糖。

example_en: The gym is less crowded on a weekday.
example_zh: 平日健身房人比較少。

example_en: She wept when she heard the sad news.
example_zh: 聽到這個壞消息時她哭了。

example_en: Did you weigh the package before sending it?
example_zh: 寄包裹前你稱過重量了嗎？

example_en: He learned how to weld metal in vocational school.
example_zh: 他在職業學校學會了如何焊接金屬。

example_en: Exercise is essential for your overall well-being.
example_zh: 運動對於你的整體身心健康至關重要。

example_en: Paris is a well-known tourist destination.
example_zh: 巴黎是一個著名的旅遊勝地。

example_en: Many Westerners enjoy spicy food.
example_zh: 許多西方人喜歡吃辣的食物。

example_en: The ship docked at the busy wharf.
example_zh: 船停泊在繁忙的碼頭。

definition_zh: 無論什麼（用於否定句加強語氣）
example_en: There is no doubt whatsoever.
example_zh: 毫無疑問。

example_en: The building is accessible for people in wheelchairs.
example_zh: 這棟大樓對於坐輪椅的人是無障礙的。

example_en: Her current whereabouts are unknown.
example_zh: 她目前的行蹤不明。

example_en: They proposed a plan whereby we could save money.
example_zh: 他們提出了一個我們能省錢的方案。

example_en: Choose whichever color you like best.
example_zh: 選你最喜歡的顏色。

example_en: The dog started to whine when it heard the thunder.
example_zh: 狗聽到雷聲後開始哀鳴。

example_en: The driver cracked his whip to urge the horses.
example_zh: 車夫甩響鞭子催趕馬匹。

example_en: The dancer whirled across the floor.
example_zh: 舞者旋轉著穿過地板。

example_en: Whisk the eggs until they are fluffy.
example_zh: 將雞蛋打發直到蓬鬆。

example_en: He ordered a glass of whiskey on the rocks.
example_zh: 他點了一杯加冰威士忌。
special_usage: Spelling: 'whisky' is also used (拼寫：'whisky' 亦可用)

example_en: She whispered a secret into his ear.
example_zh: 她在他耳邊低聲說了個秘密。

example_en: He began to whistle a happy tune.
example_zh: 他開始吹起一首輕快的曲子。

example_en: Whoever is responsible for this will be punished.
example_zh: 無論是誰對此負責都將受到懲罰。

example_en: We should eat more wholesome food.
example_zh: 我們應該多吃有益健康的食物。

example_en: The government plans to widen the road.
example_zh: 政府計劃加寬這條道路。

example_en: She became a widow at the age of 40.
example_zh: 她在40歲時成了寡婦。

example_en: The widower raised his two children alone.
example_zh: 這位鰥夫獨自撫養他的兩個孩子。

example_en: The actor wore a wig for the role.
example_zh: 那位演員為了這個角色戴了假髮。

example_en: The crowd cheered wildly when the band appeared.
example_zh: 當樂隊出現時，人群瘋狂地歡呼。

example_en: There was a crack in the windshield.
example_zh: 擋風玻璃上有一道裂痕。

example_en: It was a cold and windy day.
example_zh: 那是個寒冷多風的日子。

example_en: The team signed a new left winger.
example_zh: 該隊簽下了一名新的左邊鋒。

example_en: He winked at me to signal that it was time to leave.
example_zh: 他向我使了個眼色，示意該走了。

example_en: Please wipe the table clean.
example_zh: 請把桌子擦乾淨。

example_en: He decided to withdraw from the competition.
example_zh: 他決定退出比賽。

example_en: The flowers will wither without water.
example_zh: 沒有水，花會枯萎。

example_en: The company withheld payment until the work was completed.
example_zh: 公司保留款項直到工作完成。

example_en: The building can withstand a strong earthquake.
example_zh: 這棟建築能抵擋強烈的地震。

example_en: She is known for her witty remarks.
example_zh: 她以機智的言論著稱。

example_en: He told me a tale of woe.
example_zh: 他給我講了個悲傷的故事。

example_en: Stir-fry the vegetables in a hot wok.
example_zh: 在熱鍋中翻炒蔬菜。

example_en: Excuse me, where is the women's room?
example_zh: 請問，女洗手間在哪裡？

example_en: He is trying to woo her with expensive gifts.
example_zh: 他試圖用昂貴的禮物追求她。
special_usage: 常用於指追求伴侶或爭取選票/支持

example_en: They hiked through the dense woodland.
example_zh: 他們徒步穿越了茂密的林地。

example_en: I saw a woodpecker tapping on the tree trunk.
example_zh: 我看見一隻啄木鳥在樹幹上啄木。

example_en: Please complete the exercises in your workbook.
example_zh: 請完成練習簿裡的練習。

example_en: The workman fixed the leak in the pipe.
example_zh: 工人修好了水管的漏水。

example_en: The weather conditions worsened overnight.
example_zh: 天氣狀況在一夜之間惡化了。

example_en: Without power, the electronic device is worthless.
example_zh: 沒有電，這個電子設備就毫無用處。

definition_zh: 值得的；值得花時間/金錢的
example_en: It is worthwhile to invest in your education.
example_zh: 投資在你的教育上是值得的。

example_en: He is a would-be actor waiting for his big break.
example_zh: 他是一位等待大好機會的未來演員。
special_usage: 通常置於名詞前，形容試圖擔任某角色的人

example_en: They placed a wreath on the grave.
example_zh: 他們在墳墓上放了一個花圈。

example_en: The storm caused a ship to wreck near the shore.
example_zh: 暴風雨導致一艘船在海岸附近失事。

definition_zh: 扳手（名詞）；猛扭；扭傷（動詞）
example_en: He used a wrench to tighten the bolt.
example_zh: 他用扳手擰緊了螺栓。

example_en: He had to wrestle with his conscience.
example_zh: 他內心掙扎了一番（與良知搏鬥）。
special_usage: 可用於具體的摔跤運動，也可用於比喻與困難或道德問題鬥爭

example_en: I feel wretched about forgetting her birthday.
example_zh: 我因為忘了她的生日而感到非常懊惱。

example_en: She wrung the wet clothes before hanging them.
example_zh: 她在掛起衣服前先把濕衣服擰乾。

example_en: Iron this shirt to remove the wrinkles.
example_zh: 燙這件襯衫以去除皺褶。

example_en: The doctor ordered an x-ray of her arm.
example_zh: 醫生安排照一張她手臂的X光片。
special_usage: 常作形容詞或名詞使用，如 x-ray machine

example_en: She baked a sweet potato, which is often called a yam.
example_zh: 她烤了個紅薯，那通常被稱作番薯。
special_usage: 在某些地區，Yam 指皮色較深、肉色橙紅的番薯

example_en: The boring lecture made me yawn.
example_zh: 無聊的演講讓我打哈欠。

example_en: She yearns to travel the world.
example_zh: 她渴望環遊世界。
special_usage: 通常指帶有情感的強烈渴望 (yearn for)

example_en: He started to yell when he saw the fire.
example_zh: 當他看到火時，他開始大喊。

example_en: She eats yogurt with granola for breakfast.
example_zh: 她早餐吃加了格蘭諾拉麥片的酸奶。

example_en: The farmer placed the yoke on the oxen.
example_zh: 農夫把軛架在牛身上。

example_en: The recipe requires two egg yolks.
example_zh: 這個食譜需要兩個蛋黃。

example_en: The park is full of youngsters playing soccer.
example_zh: 公園裡滿是踢足球的年輕人。

example_en: Despite his age, he has a youthful appearance.
example_zh: 儘管年紀大了，他看起來依然很年輕。

example_en: This medicine tastes yucky.
example_zh: 這藥的味道真噁心。

example_en: This cake is so yummy!
example_zh: 這塊蛋糕太好吃了！

example_en: She approached the task with great zeal.
example_zh: 她以極大的熱情投入這項任務。

example_en: We saw a herd of zebras at the zoo.
example_zh: 我們在動物園看到一群斑馬。

example_en: My jacket zipper is stuck.
example_zh: 我的夾克拉鏈卡住了。
